QASHANI:94:5-7/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:94:5-7/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:94:5-7/r2.claim: When finished with the journey through, with, and from God, set out on steadfastness and work to invite people.
QASHANI:94:5-7/r2.anchor: { فإذا فرغت } عن السير بالله وفي الله وعن الله { فانصب } في طريق الاستقامة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.claim: Sūrah Alam Nashraḥ completes the preceding sūrah: 93:6’s sheltering and other favours concerned the period before and just after prophethood, while this sūrah points to blessings after Islam spread in Arabia.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r1.anchor: It begins after Sūrah al-Ḍuḥā without any prior introduction

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.claim: The prior sūrah predicts a bright future; this one points to predictions already beginning to materialize and assures the Prophet that hardship yields to success if faced courageously.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r2.anchor: by making a reference to some such predictions which by then had shown clear signs to materialize, an emphatic assurance is sounded to the Prophet

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.claim: The discourse proceeds from inner expansion, through the recurring law of hardship with relief, to completion of the mission and disciplined use of its success.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p363/r3.anchor: Initially a reference is made to the gift of

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r19.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r19.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r19.claim: When the Prophet finishes his obligatory prayer, he should devote himself to supplication.
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r19.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الصلاة المفروضة عليك فانصب في الدعاء

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r20.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r20.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r20.claim: Another interpretation is that after finishing worship, the Prophet should devote himself to intercession.
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r20.anchor: ويقال : فإذا فرغت من العبادة فانصب في الشفاعة

QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r21.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r21.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r21.claim: Another interpretation is that after finishing worship of the self, the Prophet should devote himself inwardly with his heart.
QUSHAYRI:v3p432/r21.anchor: ويقال : فإذا فرغت من عبادة نفسك فانصب بقلبك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r3.claim: After the favors and promise of relief, the Prophet is told to continue laboring in worship when he finishes one task.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r3.anchor: أمره بأن يدأب في العبادة إذا فرغ من مثلها ولا يفتر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd interprets finishing as completing the obligatory prayer, then exerting oneself in voluntary worship; he also says it means night prayer.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r4.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود: فإذا فرغت من فرضك، فانصب في التنفل عبادة لربك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r5.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r5.claim: Mujāhid says to turn from worldly work to worship of God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r5.anchor:
وقال مجاهد:
قال فإذا فرغت من شغل دنياك، فانصب في عبادة ربك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r6.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Qatada say that after prayer one should exert oneself in supplication.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس وقتادة: فإذا فرغت من الصلاة، فانصب في الدعاء.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r7.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r7.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the Prophet should worship after finishing jihad; the author objects that jihad was prescribed in Medina.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن: فإذا فرغت من الجهاد، فانصب في العبادة. ويعترض قوله هذا بأن الجهاد فرض بالمدينة.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r8.speaker: الجمهور وأبو السمال
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r8.claim: The majority read faraghta with an open rāʾ, while Abū al-Sammāl uses kasra as a dialect; al-Zamakhsharī calls that form inelegant.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r8.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: فرغت بفتح الراء وأبو السمال: بكسرها، وهي لغة.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r9.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r9.claim: The majority read fanṣab with an ungeminated, still bāʾ; another group has the doubled form.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r9.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: فانصب بسكون الباء خفيفة، وقوم: بشدها مفتوحة من الانصاب.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r10.speaker: الإمامية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r10.claim: An anomalous Imāmī reading has fanṣib, interpreted as appointing a successor after completing the message; Ibn ʿAṭiyya says it is weak and unattested from a scholar.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p501/r10.anchor: وقرأ آخرون من الإمامية: فانصب بكسر الصاد بمعنى: إذا فرغت من الرسالة

FARRA:v3p275#2/r7.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p275#2/r7.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p275#2/r7.claim: When finished with prayer, exert yourself in supplication to God and desire Him; fanṣab derives from exertion.
FARRA:v3p275#2/r7.anchor: إذا فرغت من صلاتك، فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء وارغب. قال الفراء: فانصب من النصب.

FARRA:v3p275#2/r8.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p275#2/r8.speaker: شريح
FARRA:v3p275#2/r8.claim: Seeing two men wrestling, Shurayḥ said this is not what a person with free time is meant for; he should finish an obligation and exert himself in worship.

BINTSHATI:v1p72/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p72/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p72/r2.claim: Faragh literally means becoming empty after fullness, whether of a vessel or of the mind; Qur'anic examples use it both physically and figuratively.
BINTSHATI:v1p72/r2.anchor: الفراغ في اللغة هو الخلو بعد امتلاء. يكون مادياً حسياً مثل: فرغ الإناء

NAHHAS:v5p252/r5.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p252/r5.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p252/r5.claim: The comprehensive interpretation is that after finishing work, one should devote oneself to God and seek Him rather than become distracted from remembrance.
NAHHAS:v5p252/r5.anchor: ومن أحسن ما قيل فيه وهو جامع لجميع الأقوال أنه ينبغي إذا فرغ الإنسان من شغله أن ينتصب لله جل وعز وأن يرغب إليه وأن لا يشتغل بما يلهيه عن ذكر الله سبحانه

NAHHAS:v5p252/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p252/r6.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
NAHHAS:v5p252/r6.claim: He says he dislikes seeing someone idle, occupied neither with worldly work nor with the afterlife.
NAHHAS:v5p252/r6.anchor: وقد قال عبد الله بن مسعود ما يعجبني الإنسان أراه فارغا لا يشتغل بأمر الدنيا ولا بأمر الآخرة

DURR-FULL:v8p550/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p550/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p550/r7.claim: When finished with prayer, one should devote oneself to supplication, asking and desiring God.
DURR-FULL:v8p550/r7.anchor: وأخرج عبد بن حميد وابن جرير وابن المنذر وابن أبي حاتم وابن مردويه من طرق عن ابن عباس

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p407/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p407/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p407/r7.claim: It promises ease whenever hardship comes, urging the Prophet to endure the mission's burdens and seek God's help.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p407/r7.anchor: واتبع ذلك بوعده بأنه كلما عرض له عسر فسيجد من أمره يسرا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p414/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p414/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p414/r5.claim: The ease promise may be a parenthesis between the Prophet's raised reputation and the command to resume striving, teaching that no hardship lacks some accompanying ease; otherwise people would perish.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p414/r5.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون جملة : { فإن مع العسر يسرا } معترضة بين جملة { ورفعنا لك ذكرك }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r6.claim: The next command follows from recalling God's care and promise to ease what is difficult in the Prophet's obedience and tireless delivery of the message.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r6.anchor: تفريع على ما تقرر من التذكير باللطف والعناية ووعده وبتيسير ما هو عسير عليه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r7.claim: Faragh literally means the interior of a vessel or container being empty.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p415/r7.anchor: والفراغ : خلو باطن الظرف أو الإناء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r14.claim: After finishing one work of prophethood or worship, the Prophet should undertake another without slackening.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r14.anchor: أن يرأب على ما أمر به ولا يفتر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r15.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r15.claim: Ibn Abbas says after completing an obligatory prayer, begin voluntary worship.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r15.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: المعنى فإذا فرغت من فرضك فانصب في النفل عبادة لربك،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r16.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r16.claim: Ibn Masud interprets the command as standing in night prayer.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r16.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود: فانصب في قيام الليل،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r17.speaker: مجاهد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r17.claim: Mujahid says to turn to worship after completing worldly work.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r17.anchor: وعن مجاهد، فإذا فرغت من شغل دنياك فانصب في عبادة ربك،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r18.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r18.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r18.claim: Ibn Abbas and Qatada say to finish worship and then devote oneself to supplication.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497/r18.anchor: وقال ابن عباس وقتادة: معنى الكلام فإذا فرغت من العبادة فانصب في الدعاء.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r1.speaker: الحسن بن أبي الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r1.claim: Al-Hasan says to finish jihad and then devote oneself to worship; the author objects that jihad became obligatory in Medina.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r1.anchor: المعنى فإذا فرغت من الجهاد فانصب في العبادة، ويعترض هذا التأويل بأن الجهاد فرض بالمدينة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r2.speaker: أبو السمال
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r2.claim: Abu al-Sammal reads faraghta with kasra on the ra as a dialect form.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r2.anchor: وقرأ أبو السمال «فرغت» بكسر الراء وهي لغة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r3.speaker: النقاش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r3.claim: Al-Naqqash mentions a doubled reading meaning to travel to Medina after jihad, but calls it wrong.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r3.anchor: ومعناه إذا فرغت من الجهاد «فانصب» إلى المدينة، ذكرها النقاش منبها على أنها خطأ،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r4.speaker: بعض الإمامية
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r4.claim: A weak, anomalous Imami reading with kasra on sad says to appoint a successor after prophethood.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ آخرون من الإمامية «فانصب» بكسر الصاد بمعنى إذا فرغت من أمر النبوة «فانصب» خليفة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r5.speaker: شريح
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r5.claim: Seeing two men wrestling, Shurayh says this is not what the command to be diligent means and recites the verse.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p497#2/r5.anchor: ومر شريح على رجلين يصطرعان، وقال ليس بهذا أمر الفراغ تلا هذه الآية.

JISHUMI:v10p7463/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7463/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7463/r8.claim: Naṣb is weariness from sustained work.
JISHUMI:v10p7463/r8.anchor: والنصب: التعب، نصب ينصب: إذا تعب في عمله بالدوام فيه

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.speaker: most commentators
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.claim: Most call al-Sharḥ Makkan and place it just after Sūrah 93; Ibn ʿAbbās calls it Madinan, while some assign only vv. 5–6 to Madinah.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r1.anchor: considered by most commentators to be a Makkan sūrah, most likely revealed immediately after the preceding one. Ibn ʿAbbās is reported to have said that it is Madinan

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.claim: Some say Sūrahs 93 and 94 were originally one, since Companions recited them together in one prayer cycle without a basmalah separating them.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r3.anchor: the Companions of the Prophet would recite them together in a single prayer cycle

STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.claim: Both sūrahs present God's bounties as relief: Sūrah 93 addresses external needs, Sūrah 94 spiritual relief; 94 recalls blessings, reassures, then commands exertion and turning to God.
STUDYQURAN:94:intro/r5.anchor: Thematically both sūrahs speak of the bounties that God has provided the Prophet Muhammad as relief for the difficulties that beset him

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.claim: Ash-Sharh was revealed almost immediately after Ad-Duha and appears to continue it directly.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r1.anchor: revealed almost immediately af ter the preceding one, appears to be a direct continuation of the latter

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.speaker: Ta'us ibn Kaysan and Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.claim: They regarded Ad-Duha and Ash-Sharh as one surah and recited them in prayer without a second basmala; Asad cites Razi.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r2.anchor: Ta'us ibn Kaysan, or the Caliph Umar i bn Abd al-Aziz (known as "the Second Umar") - regarded Ad-Duha and Ash-Sharh as one surah

ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.claim: The surah addresses the Prophet first and, through him, every true follower of the Qur'an.
ASAD-NOTES:94:intro/r3.anchor: addressed in the first instance to the Prophet and, through him, to every true follower of the Qur'an

TABATABAI:94:5-8#2/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:94:5-8#2/r1.speaker: أبو جعفر وأبو عبد الله
TABATABAI:94:5-8#2/r1.claim: The Imams explain the command as finishing the prescribed prayer, devoting oneself to supplication to the Lord, and earnestly asking Him for one's need.
TABATABAI:94:5-8#2/r1.anchor: وهو المروي عن أبي جعفر وأبي عبد الله عليهما السلام

THALABI:v10p236/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p236/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p236/r1.claim: Fansab derives from exertion and means laboring diligently; another interpretation tells him to sit for tashahhud after prayer, then stand to supplicate.
THALABI:v10p236/r1.anchor: وقوله فانصب من النصب، وهو التعب والدأب في العمل

THALABI:v10p236/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p236/r2.speaker: الكلبي
THALABI:v10p236/r2.claim: When finished conveying the message, the Prophet should seek forgiveness for himself and the believers.
THALABI:v10p236/r2.anchor: عن حيان، عن الكلبي: إذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة

THALABI:v10p236/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p236/r3.speaker: جنيد
THALABI:v10p236/r3.claim: When finished with people’s affairs, he should strive in worship of God.
THALABI:v10p236/r3.anchor: عن جنيد: فإذا فرغت من أمر الخلق، فاجتهد في عبادة الحق

THALABI:v10p236/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p236/r4.speaker: أبو العباس بن عطاء
THALABI:v10p236/r4.claim: After conveying revelation, he should exert himself in seeking intercession.
THALABI:v10p236/r4.anchor: عن أبو العباس بن عطاء: فإذا فرغت من تبليغ الوحي، فانصب في طلب الشفاعة

THALABI:v10p236/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p236/r8.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v10p236/r8.claim: After worship, exert yourself in turning away from it for fear it may be rejected; desire God and seek forgiveness for your deed in shame.
THALABI:v10p236/r8.anchor: وقيل: إذا فرغت من العبادة، فانصب إلى الإعراض عنها مخافة ردها عليك

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r4.speaker: İbn Âşûr
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r4.claim: Rather than limiting the verse to one task or act of worship, Ibn Ashur reads it as moving from one important task to another so all time is filled with important work.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r4.anchor: “Önemli işlerden birini tamamlayınca ardından başka bir işe yönel ki böylece bütün vakitlerini önemli işlerle değerlendirmiş olasın” şeklindeki açıklaması isabetli görünmektedir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r5.claim: The verse asks the Prophet and, through him, Muslims to devote time to beneficial religious work—worship, prayer, proclamation, guidance—and worldly work such as production, learning, teaching, and cooperation.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:94:5/r5.anchor: ibadet, dua, tebliğ ve irşad gibi dinî faaliyetlerin de; çalışma, üretme, öğrenme-öğretme, yardımlaşma ve dayanışma gibi dünyevî faaliyetlerin de hakkını vermeleri istenilmiştir

BURSEVI:v10p357#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p357#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p357#2/r1.claim: The author rejects a fabricated Shiite reading of فانصب with kasra as commanding the appointment of Ali as imam, since an enemy could equally twist it into a command to hate him.
BURSEVI:v10p357#2/r1.anchor: ومن البدع ما روى عن بعض الرافضة أنه قرأ فانصب بكسر الصاد أي فانصب عليا للإمامة

SULAMI:v2p405#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r1.speaker: جعفر
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r1.claim: When free from everything besides God, remember Him.
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r1.anchor: قال جعفر أذكر ربك على فراغ منك عن كل ما دونه

SULAMI:v2p405#2/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r2.claim: After conveying the message, devote yourself to seeking intercession.
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : ﴿ فإذا فرغت ﴾ من تبليغ الرسالة ﴿ فانصب ﴾ لطلب الشفاعة

SULAMI:v2p405#2/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r3.speaker: القاسم
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r3.claim: After attending to people, dedicate yourself to worship.
SULAMI:v2p405#2/r3.anchor: وقال القاسم : ﴿ فإذا فرغت ﴾ من أمر الخلق ﴿ فانصب ﴾ نفسك في عبادته

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says when one finishes prayer, one should exert oneself in supplication, asking God and turning to Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : فاذا فرغت فانصب الاية قال : اذا فرغت من الصلاة فانصب في الدعاء

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r2.claim: Al-Dahhak reports Ibn Masud's view that completing bowing and prostration permits a person to make a request while still seated.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r2.anchor: عن الضحاك قال : كان ابن مسعود يقول : ايما رجل احدث في اخر صلاته فقد تمت صلاته

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r3.claim: Ibn Masud says after finishing obligatory prayers one should devote oneself to night prayer.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#2/r3.anchor: عن ابن مسعود فاذا فرغت فانصب قال : اذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r1.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r1.claim: Mujahid says after finishing one's own affairs, one should pray to God and direct one's desire toward Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله : فاذا فرغت فانصب قال : اذا فرغت من اسباب نفسك فصل إلى ربك

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r2.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r2.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says when one finishes fighting, one should devote oneself to worship.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3446#3/r2.anchor: عن زيد بن اسلم فاذا فرغت فانصب قال : اذا فرغت من الجهاد فتعبد

TUSTARI:94:7/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:94:7/r1.claim: Outwardly, after finishing the obligatory prayer while seated, the Prophet is to devote himself to his Lord; inwardly, he returns beyond the natural self to his prior solitary, secret station.
TUSTARI:94:7/r1.anchor: من صلاتك المكتوبة وأنت جالس { فانصب } [7] إلى ربك وارجع إليه، كما كنت قبل نفس الطبع،

TUSTARI:94:7/r2.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:94:7/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
TUSTARI:94:7/r2.claim: The Prophet is reported to have said that he has an intimate time with God that admits no other.
TUSTARI:94:7/r2.anchor:
كما قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" إن لي مع الله وقتا لا يسعني غيره

TUSTARI:94:7/r3.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:94:7/r3.speaker: أبو عمرو بن العلاء
TUSTARI:94:7/r3.claim: Abu Amr recounts fleeing al-Hajjaj and hearing a Bedouin recite that patience lifts grief and hardship may open unexpectedly; a messenger then announced al-Hajjaj's death.
TUSTARI:94:7/r3.anchor: وحكى أبو عمرو بن العلاء فقال: " هربنا من الحجاج فدخلنا البادية فأقمنا بها دهرا

TUSTARI:94:7/r4.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:94:7/r4.speaker: أبو عمرو بن العلاء
TUSTARI:94:7/r4.claim: The Bedouin distinguishes a gap in a wall or stick, pronounced with damma, from an opening in distress, pronounced with fatha; Abu Amr was pleased by the word lesson.
TUSTARI:94:7/r4.anchor: فقال: الفرجة بضم الفاء: في الحائط والعود ونحوهما، والفرجة بفتح الفاء: في الأمر من الشدة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r1.claim: Faraghta implies that the person was occupied; leaving a task means completing it. The object is omitted because the context points to the Prophet's demanding mission.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r1.anchor: وفعل فرغ يفيد أن فاعله كان مملوءا بشيء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r2.claim: After finishing one major task, the Prophet should undertake another, filling his time with important work; fansab is the main command, while 'when free' prepares and sequences that work.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r2.anchor: فالمعنى إذا أتممت عملا من مهام الأعمال فأقبل على عمل آخر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r3.speaker: محمد
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r3.claim: A report says the Prophet, returning from an expedition, called the return a move from the lesser jihad to the greater jihad.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r3.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عند قفوله من إحدى غزواته

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r4.claim: Early exegetes differ only by examples of what task is completed; omission gives the contextual category broad scope, including work prioritized as possible, as prayer alongside fighting shows.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r4.anchor: واختلفت أقوال المفسرين من السلف في تعيين المفروغ منه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r5.claim: The rule includes the Prophet's particular duties: night prayer, jihad when Muslims are strong, and managing communal affairs; fronting the time clause emphasizes sequential work.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r5.anchor: وهذا الحكم ينسحب على كل عمل ممكن من أعماله الخاصة به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r6.claim: This comprehensive maxim continues the command to thank God by asking that His favors endure, as gratitude brings increase.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p416/r6.anchor: عطف على تفريع الأمر بالشكر على النعم أمر بطلب استمرار نعم الله تعالى عليه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r1.claim: Raghiba ordinarily takes the desired object with fī and the one asked directly; raghiba an means turning away. Aisha reads the omitted preposition in 4:127 as an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r1.anchor: والرغبة : طلب حصول ما هو محبوب وأصله أن يعدى إلى المطلوب منه بنفسه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r4.claim: The fā in fansab and farghab links the actions because fronted complements imply restriction and hence a conditional sense; Qur'anic examples show this pattern.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r4.anchor: واعلم أن الفاء في قوله : { فانصب } ( الشرح : 7 ) وقوله : { فارغب } رابطة للفعل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r6.speaker: الطيبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r6.claim: Al-Tibi cites Ibn al-Shajari's puzzlement that waw and fā meet here, since fā ordinarily marks coordination, an answer, or a relative clause; Ibn Ashur says his analysis removes the puzzle.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p417/r6.anchor: وذكر الطيبي عن ( أمالي السيد ) ( يعني ابن الشجري ) أن اجتماع الفاء والواو

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r1.claim: The general command is to persist in work; the word denotes fatigue and sustained exertion.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r1.anchor: أي فادأب في العمل وهو من النصب والنصب التعب الدؤوب في العمل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r2.claim: When finished with obligatory prayers, devote yourself to night prayer.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r2.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل قاله ابن مسعود

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r3.speaker: ابن عباس والضحاك ومقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r3.claim: When finished with prayer, devote yourself to supplication.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r3.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الصلاة فانصب في الدعاء قاله ابن عباس والضحاك ومقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r4.claim: When finished with worldly affairs, devote yourself to work for the afterlife.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r4.anchor: فإذا فرغت من أمر دنياك فانصب في عمل آخرتك قاله مجاهد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r5.speaker: الشعبي والزهري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r5.claim: When finished with the tashahhud, pray for your worldly and afterlife needs.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r5.anchor: فإذا فرغت من التشهد فادع لدنياك وآخرتك قاله الشعبي والزهري

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r6.speaker: علي ابن أبي طلحة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r6.claim: When healthy, put that strength into exertion in worship.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p166/r6.anchor: إذا صح بدنك فاجعل صحتك نصبا في العبادة ذكره علي ابن أبي طلحة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r1.claim: After worldly affairs and their attachments end, one should turn energetically to worship with an unoccupied mind and sincere intention and longing for God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r1.anchor: وقوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب وإلى ربك فارغب} أي: إذا فرغت من أمور الدنيا وأشغالها وقطعت علائقها، فانصب في العبادة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r2.claim: The Prophet says not to pray when food is present or while resisting the two bodily calls; Ibn Kathir says the report is agreed sound.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r2.anchor: قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم في الحديث المتفق على صحته: "لا صلاة بحضرة طعام، ولا وهو يدافعه الأخبثان"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r3.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r3.claim: When prayer is called while dinner is served, the Prophet says to begin with dinner.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r3.anchor: وقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إذا أقيمت الصلاة وحضر العشاء، فابدءوا بالعشاء"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r4.claim: Mujahid says that after finishing worldly affairs and rising for prayer, one should devote oneself energetically to God; another report says to strive in one's need when beginning prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r4.anchor: قال مجاهد في هذه الآية: إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فقمت إلى الصلاة، فانصب لربك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r5.claim: Ibn Mas'ud says to exert oneself in night vigil after obligatory prayers; another report from him says to strive after prayer while sitting.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r5.anchor: وعن ابن مسعود: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل. وعن ابن عياض نحوه. وفي رواية عن ابن مسعود

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas explains 'when you finish, strive' as devoting oneself to supplication.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r6.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طلحة، عن ابن عباس: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} يعني: في الدعاء.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r7.speaker: زيد بن أسلم، الضحاك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r7.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam and al-Dahhak say that after finishing jihad one should devote oneself to worship.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p433/r7.anchor: وقال زيد بن أسلم، والضحاك: {فإذا فرغت} أي: من الجهاد {فانصب} أي: في العبادة.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p532#5/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p532#5/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p532#5/r1.claim: After finishing prayer, engage in supplication and direct your desire to God.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p532#5/r1.anchor: {فإذا فرغت} من صلاتك: {فانصب} في الدعاء، وارغب إلى الله.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r1.speaker: قتادة والضحاك
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r1.claim: After finishing prayer, one should exert oneself in supplication and asking God for needs.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r1.anchor: قيل: إذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء ومسألة الحوائج، وارغب إليه، عن قتادة، والضحاك.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r2.claim: After finishing an obligatory duty, one should strive in the work God has encouraged.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r2.anchor: وقيل: إذا فرغت من فرضك فانصب إلى ما رغبك الله فيه من العمل، عن ابن عباس.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r3.speaker: الحسن وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r3.claim: After jihad against enemies, one should devote oneself to worship.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r3.anchor: وقيل: إذا فرغت من جهاد أعدائك فانصب إلى ربك بالعبادة له، عن الحسن، وابن زيد.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r4.speaker: مجاهد وأبو علي
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r4.claim: After worldly affairs are done, one should devote oneself to worship.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r4.anchor: وقيل: إذا فرغت من أمور دنياك فانصب إلى عبادة ربك، عن مجاهد، وأبي علي.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r5.speaker: أبو مسلم
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r5.claim: When alone, exert oneself in worship: farāgh means solitude and naṣb means exertion; turn to God so relief follows hardship.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r5.anchor: والفراغ: الخلو، والنصب: التعب، فأمره بالعبادة عند خلوه، والرغبة إليه ليأتيه اليسر بعد العسر، عن أبي مسلم.

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r6.claim: Other views direct effort to conveying the message and worship after worldly necessities, to struggling against the self after enemy jihad, or to seeking intercession after completing the mission.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r6.anchor: إذا فرغت مما لا بد لك منه من أمور دنياك فانصب لما تعبدت به من الإبلاغ والعبادة

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r7.claim: Another interpretation calls for remembrance of God when the heart is free of prophetic and messenger duties.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r7.anchor: أراد ذكر الله على فراغ القلب من أمر النبوة وأعباء الرسالة

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r8.speaker: الأصم
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r8.claim: Al-Aṣamm says that after bowing, prostration, and recitation one should exert oneself in supplication.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r8.anchor: إذا فرغت من الركوع والسجود والقراءة فانصب إلى ربك بالدعاء، عن الأصم،

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r9.claim: Some say this commands jihad, but the author rejects that because the surah is Meccan and jihad had not yet begun.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r9.anchor: وحكي عن قوم أن المراد به الأمر بالجهاد، وزيفه بأن السورة مكية، ولم يك ثم جهاد،

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r10.claim: One should seek forgiveness for believers after delivering the message and turn to God in every circumstance for religious and worldly needs.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r10.anchor: إذا فرغت من أداء الرسالة فانصب للاستغفار للمؤمنين، وإلى ربك فارغب في جميع أحوالك،

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r11.claim: The idea that Sūrat al-Ḍuḥā and Sūrat al-Sharḥ are one surah is false: the basmala separates them and transmitted agreement establishes two surahs.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r11.anchor: وهذا باطل؛ لأنا بالطريق الذي به علمنا [فصل] السورة بذلك علمنا أنهما سورتان

JISHUMI:v10p7466/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r12.claim: The surah teaches that God's blessings on the Prophet and his community require gratitude.
JISHUMI:v10p7466/r12.anchor: منها: بيان نعم الله على نبيه الموجبة للشكر، ونعمه على أمته به.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r1.claim: After past favors and future promises, God urges gratitude and strenuous worship, with each act followed by another so time is not left empty.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r1.anchor: بعثه على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة والنصب فيها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says to exert oneself in supplication after finishing prayer.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r2.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فاجتهد في الدعاء

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r3.claim: Hasan says to exert oneself in worship after finishing a campaign.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r3.anchor: وعن الحسن : فإذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r4.speaker: مجاهد
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r4.claim: Mujahid says that after finishing worldly business one should devote oneself to prayer.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r4.anchor: وعن مجاهد : فإذا فرغت من دنياك فانصب في صلاتك

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r5.speaker: الشعبي
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r5.claim: Al-Shabi rebuked a man moving stones as not following the order for the idle; pointless idleness signals folly, and Umar disliked anyone without worldly or religious work.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r5.anchor: وقعود الرجل فارغا من غير شغل أو اشتغاله بما لا يعينه في دينه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r6.speaker: أبو السمال
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r6.claim: Abu al-Sammal reads faraghta with kasra on ra, which the author calls inelegant.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ أبو السمال : فرغت بكسر الراء وليست بفصيحة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r7.claim: The author rejects a Shiite reading of fansib as appointing Ali imam; if accepted, a hostile reading could turn it into an order to hate Ali.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r7.anchor: ومن البدع : ما روى عن بعض الرافضة أنه قرأ : ( فانصب )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r9.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r9.claim: A report compares reciting al-Inshirah to coming to the Prophet distressed and relieving him.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p777#2/r9.anchor: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( 1317 ) ( من قرأ ألم نشرح

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r1.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r1.claim: He says after completing the obligatory prayers, devote yourself to standing in night prayer.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r1.anchor: من الفرائض فانصب من قيام الليل , قاله ابن مسعود

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r2.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r2.claim: He says after finishing prayer, devote yourself to supplication.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r2.anchor: من صلاتك فانصب في دعائك , قاله الضحاك

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r3.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r3.claim: They say after finishing jihad against the enemy, devote yourself to worship of your Lord.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r3.anchor: من جهادك عدوك فانصب لعبادة ربك , قاله الحسن وقتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r4.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r4.claim: He says after completing worldly affairs, devote yourself to work for the afterlife.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r4.anchor: من أمر دنياك فانصب في عمل آخرتك , قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p298/r5.claim: A further possibility is that after delivering the message, devote yourself to fighting the enemy.

MUJAHID:v2p768/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p768/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p768/r1.claim: Mujahid says that when the Prophet rises to pray, he should strive in supplication to his Lord.
MUJAHID:v2p768/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد ﴿ فإذا فرغت فانصب ﴾ قال يقول إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصب في حاجتك إلى ربك

NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r1.claim: After finishing the call to people, the Prophet should devote himself energetically to worshiping his Lord and link one act of worship to another; the command follows the recounting of past and promised favors by urging gratitude.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r1.anchor: أى فاذا فرغت من دعوة الخلق فاجتهد فى عبادة الرب

NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets the command as striving in supplication after completing prayer; authorities differ whether this is before or after the salutation.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p346#6/r2.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فاجتهد فى الدعاء واختلف أنه قبل السلام أو بعده

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas and Qatada say that after prayer the Prophet should strive in supplication and ask God for his need.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس وقتادة: فإذا فرغت من صلاتك { فانصب } أي بالغ في الدعاء

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r2.claim: Ibn Masud interprets the command as turning to night prayer after finishing the obligatory prayers.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r2.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r3.speaker: الكلبي
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi says that after conveying the message the Prophet should seek forgiveness for his sin and for believing men and women.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r3.anchor: وقال الكلبي: إذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة «فانصب» أي استغفر لذنبك

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.claim: Hasan and Qatada also say that after finishing jihad against the enemy one should devote oneself to worship of the Lord.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.anchor: وقال الحسن وقتادة أيضا: إذا فرغت من جهاد عدوك، فانصب لعبادة ربك.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r5.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r5.claim: Mujahid interprets the worldly task as something to finish before engaging in prayer; Hasan has a similar view.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r6.speaker: الجنيد
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r6.claim: Junayd says that when one is done with created beings, one should strive in worship of the Creator.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r6.anchor: وقال الجنيد: إذا فرغت من أمر الخلق، فاجتهد في عبادة الحق.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r7.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r7.claim: Ibn al-Arabi rejects a deviant reading that changes the command into appointing a successor imam, calling both its recitation and interpretation false because the Prophet appointed no successor.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r7.anchor: قال ابن العربي: «ومن المبتدعة من قرأ هذه الآية «فانصب» بكسر الصاد، والهمز من أوله،

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r8.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r8.claim: Ibn al-Arabi rejects another ignorant reading with a doubled b as contradicting consensus, though its proposed sense of returning home after jihad is correct and supported by a Prophetic travel report.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r8.anchor: وقرأها بعض: الجهال «فانصب» بتشديد الباء، معناه: إذا فرغت من الجهاد،

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r9.claim: The Prophet says travel is a portion of torment that disrupts sleep, food, and drink, so after one's need is met one should hurry back to one's family.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r9.anchor: السفر قطعة من العذاب، يمنع أحدكم نومه وطعامه وشرابه، فإذا قضى أحدكم نهمته،

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r10.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r10.claim: Ibn al-Arabi warns that attaching a true meaning to an invented reading or report makes one a liar against God and His Messenger.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r10.anchor: من أخذ معنى صحيحا، فركب عليه من قبل نفسه قراءة أو حديثا، فيكون كاذبا على الله

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r13.speaker: أبو السمال
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r13.claim: Abu al-Samal reads faraghta with a kasra on the ghayn, a dialect form.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r13.anchor: وروي عن أبي السمال «فإذا فرغت» بكسر الراء، وهي لغة فيه.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r15.speaker: شريح
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r15.claim: Ibn al-Arabi reports that Shurayh objected to people playing on a festival day, saying the Lawgiver had not commanded it, but Ibn al-Arabi questions this objection.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r15.anchor: روي عن شريح أنه مر بقوم يلعبون يوم عيد، فقال ما بهذا أمر الشارع.

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r16.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r16.claim: Ibn al-Arabi counters Shurayh by noting that Abyssinians played with shields and spears in the mosque on Eid while the Prophet watched.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r16.anchor: فإن الحبش كانوا يلعبون بالدرق والحراب في المسجد يوم العيد

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r17.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r17.claim: When Abu Bakr objected to two Ansari girls singing, the Prophet told him to leave them because it was a festival day.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8/r17.anchor: فقال: «دعهما يا أبا بكر، فإنه يوم عيد

QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8#2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8#2/r1.claim: Constant, uninterrupted work is not required; sustained application is disliked for ordinary people.
QURTUBI-FULL:94:7-8#2/r1.anchor: وليس يلزم الدؤوب على العمل، بل هو مكروه للخلق.

QUTB-ZILAL:94:7/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:94:7/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:94:7/r1.claim: When the Prophet finishes work among people and worldly concerns, he should turn all his effort toward worship, detachment, aspiration, and devotion to God.
QUTB-ZILAL:94:7/r1.anchor: إذا فرغت من هذا كله فتوجه بقلبك كله إذن إلى ما يستحق أن تنصب فيه وتكد وتجهد

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r1.claim: The command follows past and promised blessings by urging gratitude and strenuous worship; nasab means to toil, and the general rule is to replace one act of worship with another without leaving time empty.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r1.anchor: وجه تعلق هذا بما قبله أنه تعالى لما عدد عليه نعمه السالفة ، ووعدهم بالنعم الآتية ، لا جرم بعثه على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r2.speaker: قتادة والضحاك ومقاتل
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r2.claim: After the obligatory prayer, stand in supplication and ask God, who will give you what you request.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r2.anchor: قال قتادة والضحاك ومقاتل : إذا فرغت من الصلاة المكتوبة { فانصب * إلى ربك } في الدعاء وارغب إليه

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r3.speaker: الشعبي
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r3.claim: Al-Sha'bi interprets it as praying for worldly and next-worldly needs after the tashahhud.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r3.anchor: وقال الشعبي : إذا فرغت من التشهد فادع لدنياك وآخرتك

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r4.speaker: مجاهد
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r4.claim: Mujahid says that when worldly affairs are finished, one should rise and pray.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r4.anchor: وقال مجاهد : إذا فرغت من أمر دنياك فانصب وصل

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r5.speaker: عبد الله
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r5.claim: Abdullah says that after fulfilling the required prayers, one should exert oneself in night worship.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r5.anchor: وقال عبد الله : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r6.speaker: الحسن
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r6.claim: Al-Hasan says that after a campaign, one should devote oneself to worship.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن : إذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r7.speaker: علي بن أبي طلحة
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r7.claim: Ali ibn Abi Talha says that when healthy and free, one should spend that leisure in worship.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r7.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طلحة : إذا كنت صحيحا فانصب ، يعني اجعل فراغك نصبا في العبادة

RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r8.speaker: شريح
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r8.claim: Passing two men wrestling, Shurayh rebuked them as idle people, since the verse commands effort when free.
RAZI-FULL:v32p7#3/r8.anchor: يدل عليه ما روى أن شريحا مر برجلين يتصارعان ، فقال : الفارغ ما أمر بهذا إنما قال الله : { فإذا فرغت فانصب }

SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r1.claim: The common reading has fatḥa on the rāʾ of faraghta; Abū al-Sammāl reads kasra, a dialect al-Zamakhsharī calls inelegant.
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r1.anchor: العامة على فتح الراء من " فرغت " وهي الشهيرة، وقرأها أبو السمال مكسورة

SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī links the command to strive with the preceding blessings and promises: they should prompt gratitude and diligent worship; Ibn ʿAbbās glosses it as finishing prayer then supplicating.
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r2.anchor: لما عدد نعمه السالفة ووعده الآنفة بعثة على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة. عن ابن عباس: فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب في الدعاء

SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r3.claim: The common fanṣab is an imperative from naṣaba; a doubled-bāʾ reading is attributed to al-inṣibāb, while a kasra-on-ṣād reading is considered suspect.
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r3.anchor: والعامة على فتح الصاد وسكون الباء أمرا من النصب وقرئ بتشديد الباء متفوحة أمرا من الأنصباب

SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls the Shīʿī interpretation of finishing prophethood and appointing a successor weak, anomalous, and unauthenticated from any scholar.
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r4.anchor: قال ابن عطية: " وهي قراءة ضعيفة شاذة لم تثبت عن عالم

SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī calls the claim that fanṣab commands appointing ʿAlī an innovation, arguing that a hostile reading could analogously make it command hating him.
SAMIN-DURR:94:7/r5.anchor: ومن البدع ما روي عن بعض الرافضة أنه قرأ " فانصب " أي: انصب عليا للإمامة

STUDYQURAN:94:7/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r1.speaker: al-Bayḍāwī; al-Jalālayn; al-Ṭabarī
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r1.claim: One reading is: after obligatory devotions, turn to supplication and supererogatory worship.
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r1.anchor: after completing the obligatory devotions, one should supplicate the Lord and perform supererogatory devotions

STUDYQURAN:94:7/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r2.speaker: al-Ṭabarī
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r2.claim: Another reading says that when free from worldly affairs one should pray.
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r2.anchor: when free from worldly affairs, one should pray

STUDYQURAN:94:7/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r3.claim: A further reading urges one, once devoted to God, continually to deepen prayer.
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r3.anchor: So when thou art devoted [to God], exert thyself,” meaning that one should always seek to deepen one’s prayers

STUDYQURAN:94:7/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r4.claim: If the phrase means when spent, it calls for unceasing striving in God's way and in doing His will.
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r4.anchor: So when thou art spent, toil,” meaning one should never cease to strive in the way of God

STUDYQURAN:94:7/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r5.speaker: al-Bayḍāwī; al-Shāfiʿī; al-Ṭabarī
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r5.claim: Another interpretation is to worship the Lord after being free from striving against enemies.
STUDYQURAN:94:7/r5.anchor: When thou art free from striving against thine enemies, exert thyself in worshipping the Lord

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās interprets finishing as completing prayer and then turning to supplication and asking God for one's needs.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس، في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] يقول: في الدعاء

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r2.claim: Another report from Ibn ʿAbbās says that after fulfilling the obligatory prayer, ask and turn toward God.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] يقول: فإذا فرغت مما فرض عليك من الصلاة فسل الله

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r3.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r3.claim: Mujāhid says that when one rises for prayer, one should make one's request to God.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] قال: إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصب في حاجتك إلى ربك

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r4.speaker: الضحاك
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r4.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says to make supplication during the obligatory prayer before the salām.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r4.anchor: سمعت الضحاك، يقول، في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] يقول: من الصلاة المكتوبة قبل أن تسلم

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r5.claim: Qatāda says that after prayer the Prophet was commanded to devote himself earnestly to supplication.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب وإلى ربك فارغب} [الشرح: 8] قال: أمره إذا فرغ من صلاته أن يبالغ في دعائه

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r6.speaker: الحسن
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan says that after finishing a campaign the Prophet should strive in supplication and worship.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r6.anchor: قال الحسن في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] قال: أمره إذا فرغ من غزوه، أن يجتهد في الدعاء والعبادة

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd interprets the command as moving from the end of the Arab campaigns to worshipping God.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r7.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] قال عن أبيه: فإذا فرغت من الجهاد، جهاد العرب

TAB-FULL:v24p498/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r8.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r8.claim: Mujāhid says that when finished with worldly business, one should stand to pray.
TAB-FULL:v24p498/r8.anchor: عن مجاهد، {فإذا فرغت فانصب} [الشرح: 7] قال: إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فانصب، قال: فصل

TAB-FULL:v24p499/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r1.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r1.claim: Mujāhid says that on finishing worldly affairs and standing for prayer, one should direct intention and desire to God.
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد، في قوله: {فإذا فرغت} [الشرح: 7] قال: إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا، وقمت إلى الصلاة

TAB-FULL:v24p499/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r2.claim: Ṭabarī prefers the general sense: whatever occupied the Prophet, in religious or worldly matters, prayer or campaigning, when finished he should devote himself to worship and supplication; the condition is not limited to one kind of task.
TAB-FULL:v24p499/r2.anchor: وأولى الأقوال في ذلك بالصواب، قول من قال: إن الله تعالى ذكره، أمر نبيه أن يجعل فراغه من كل ما كان به مشتغلا

TABRISI:94:1/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:1/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:94:1/r4.claim: Nasb means fatigue; worry makes someone tired and afflicted.
TABRISI:94:1/r4.anchor: والنصب التعب وأنصبه الهم فهو منصب

TABRISI:94:1/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:1/r5.speaker: الشاعر
TABRISI:94:1/r5.claim: An anonymous poet uses mansab to describe a consuming worry and fatigue.

TABRISI:94:1/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:1/r6.speaker: النابغة
TABRISI:94:1/r6.claim: Al-Nabigha's line uses nasib for a burdensome, tiring worry.

TABRISI:94:7-8/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:94:7-8/r2.claim: The command to strive derives from fatigue and means not to occupy oneself with rest.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r2.anchor: ومعنى انصب من النصب وهو التعب أي لا تشتغل بالراحة

TABRISI:94:7-8/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r3.speaker: الزهري
TABRISI:94:7-8/r3.claim: After completing the obligations, make supplication after the tashahhud with all one's needs.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r3.anchor: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فادع بعد التشهد بكل حاجتك

TABRISI:94:7-8/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r4.speaker: الصادق
TABRISI:94:7-8/r4.claim: The verse means supplication after prayer while sitting.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r4.anchor: هو الدعاء في دبر الصلاة وأنت جالس

TABRISI:94:7-8/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
TABRISI:94:7-8/r5.claim: After the obligatory prayers, devote oneself to standing in night prayer.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r5.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل عن ابن مسعود

TABRISI:94:7-8/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r6.speaker: مجاهد والجبائي
TABRISI:94:7-8/r6.claim: Alternatively, after finishing worldly affairs, devote effort to worship and prayer.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r6.anchor: فإذا فرغت من دنياك فانصب في عبادة ربك وصل عن مجاهد والجبائي

TABRISI:94:7-8/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:94:7-8/r7.claim: After the obligations, strive in the good works God has encouraged and pray.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r7.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب فيما رغبك الله فيه من الأعمال وصل عن ابن عباس

TABRISI:94:7-8/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r8.speaker: الحسن وابن زيد
TABRISI:94:7-8/r8.claim: When finished with fighting enemies, devote oneself to worship of God.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r8.anchor: إذا فرغت من جهاد أعدائك فانصب بالعبادة لله عن الحسن وابن زيد

TABRISI:94:7-8/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r9.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:94:7-8/r9.claim: Another interpretation is to finish fighting the enemy and then struggle against one's own soul.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r9.anchor: فإذا فرغت من جهاد الأعداء فانصب بجهاد نفسك

TABRISI:94:7-8/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r10.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:94:7-8/r10.claim: Another interpretation is to finish delivering the message and then strive to seek intercession.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r10.anchor: من أداء الرسالة فانصب لطلب الشفاعة

TABRISI:94:7-8/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:94:7-8/r11.speaker: علي بن طلحة
TABRISI:94:7-8/r11.claim: After noting the many interpretations, he transmits the saying that one should make health and free time an exertion in worship.
TABRISI:94:7-8/r11.anchor: إذا صححت فاجعل صحتك وفراغك نصبا في العبادة

THALABI:v10p235/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v10p235/r6.claim: After finishing prayer, devote yourself to supplication, ask God for what you need, and earnestly turn to Him.
THALABI:v10p235/r6.anchor: قال ابن عباس: إذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء، واسأله حاجتك

THALABI:v10p235/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r7.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v10p235/r7.claim: He says that when you rise to pray, make your petition to your Lord with effort.
THALABI:v10p235/r7.anchor: عن مجاهد: إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصب في حاجتك إلى ربك

THALABI:v10p235/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r8.speaker: الضحاك
THALABI:v10p235/r8.claim: After the obligatory prayer, while still seated and before the salām, devote yourself to supplication.
THALABI:v10p235/r8.anchor: الضحاك: إذا فرغت من الصلاة المكتوبة فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء، وأنت جالس قبل أن تسلم

THALABI:v10p235/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r9.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v10p235/r9.claim: The command is to intensify supplication when finished with prayer.
THALABI:v10p235/r9.anchor: قتادة: أمره أن يبالغ في دعائه إذا فرغ من صلاته

THALABI:v10p235/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r10.speaker: الحسن
THALABI:v10p235/r10.claim: After finishing the struggle against the enemy, devote yourself to worshiping your Lord.
THALABI:v10p235/r10.anchor: عن الحسن: إذا فرغت من جهاد عدوك، فانصب في عبادة ربك

THALABI:v10p235/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r11.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
THALABI:v10p235/r11.claim: After the Arab campaign ends, devote yourself to worshiping God and turn to Him.
THALABI:v10p235/r11.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم: إذا فرغت من جهاد العرب وانقطع جهادهم، فانصب لعبادة الله وإليه فارغب

THALABI:v10p235/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r12.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v10p235/r12.claim: When worldly affairs are finished, devote yourself to worship and prayer.
THALABI:v10p235/r12.anchor: عن منصور، عن مجاهد: إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فانصب في عبادة ربك وصل

THALABI:v10p235/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r13.speaker: شريح
THALABI:v10p235/r13.claim: He rebuked two wrestlers: free time is for the worship and turning to God commanded here, not wrestling.
THALABI:v10p235/r13.anchor: شريح برجلين يصطرعان فقال: ليس بهذا أمر الفارغ، إنما قال الله عز وجل: فإذا فرغت فانصب وإلى ربك

THALABI:v10p235/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p235/r14.speaker: الفراء
THALABI:v10p235/r14.claim: He explains Shurayḥ’s point as applying when someone finishes prayer or any other task.
THALABI:v10p235/r14.anchor: قال الفراء: فكأنه في قول شريح: إذا فرغ الفارغ من الصلاة أو غيرها

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p136/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p136/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p136/r1.claim: When finished, exert yourself; the verb naṣiba means to toil or tire, with naṣiba yanṣabu as its paradigm.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r2.speaker: عبد الله
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r2.claim: When finished with the obligatory prayers, devote yourself to night prayer.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r2.anchor: وقال عبد الله: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل (¬7).

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r3.speaker: علي بن أبي طلحة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r3.claim: One reported interpretation says that when sound and free of work, a person should devote health and spare time to worship; Abū ʿIyāḍ agrees, citing Shurayḥ's rebuke of two wrestlers as a misuse of free time.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r3.anchor: وسئل علي بن أبي طلحة عن هذه الآية فقال: القول فيه كبير، وقد سمعنا أنه يقال: إذا صححت فانصب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r4.speaker: الحسن
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r4.claim: After finishing the fight against the enemy, devote yourself to worship and direct your hopes to God; Zayd ibn Aslam agrees.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p137/r4.anchor: وقال الحسن (¬3)، وزيد بن أسلم (¬4): إذا فرغت من جهاد العدو فانصب في عبادة ربك

WAHIDI-QT:94:7/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:94:7/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:94:7/r1.claim: After prayer, Muhammad should exert himself in supplication, ask his need, and turn to God.
WAHIDI-QT:94:7/r1.anchor: { فإذا فرغت } من صلاتك { فانصب } أي اتعب في الدعاء وسله حاجتك وارغب إلى الله تعالى به

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:7/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:7/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:7/r1.claim: After finishing prayer, exert yourself in supplication, ask God for what you need, and turn to Him earnestly.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:94:7/r1.anchor: فإذا فرغت } من صلاتك { فانصب } أي: اتعب في الدعاء وسله حاجتك، وارغب إلى الله تعالى به.

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r1.claim: When finished with one duty or worship, fulfilled an obligation, or moved from hardship to ease and rested, the Prophet should take up further effort rather than settle into leisure.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r1.anchor: bir vazifeden, bir ibadetten fâriğ olup bir usrdan bir yüsre geçtiğin, biraz dinlendiğin, meselâ

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r2.claim: Nasab means toil: after a duty, move from obligatory worship to voluntary worship or from prayer to supplication, continuing to work and tire oneself.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r2.anchor: yine yorul iş bitti diye rahata düşüp kalma da yine zahmet ihtiyar edip diğer bir ibadet için kalk, çalış, yorul, farz bittiyse nâfileye geç

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r3.claim: Ease should spur further striving, so each new ease produces progress and sustained gratitude rather than idleness.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r3.anchor: Yüsr atâlete sâik olmamalı sa‘ye müşevvik olmalıdır

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r6.claim: The surah yields the maxims that hardship gives way to ease, reward corresponds to burden, and rulings follow intentions.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r6.anchor: Bu sûreden şu kāideler istihrac olunur:

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r7.claim: Working for God's sake leads one to God, completing the maxim about deeds being judged by intentions.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r7.anchor: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ bir işten maksad ne ise hüküm ona göredir. Allah için çalışan Allah’a erer

ELMALILI:94:7-8/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r8.claim: These surahs move from the Prophet's condition to broader believers' destiny, passing from blessing to its Giver before al-Tin affirms the afterlife and religion.
ELMALILI:94:7-8/r8.anchor: ferdin hâlinden nev‘in hâline ve mü’minlerin âkıbetinin de güzelliğine geçilerek bu iki sûrenin bir bağlanışı

CORPUSCORANICUM:94:7-8:kommentar/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:7-8:kommentar/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:7-8:kommentar/r1.claim: Fariġa, finishing something, and naṣiba, exerting oneself, form a semantic contrast, though less obvious than the earlier contrast between hardship and ease.
CORPUSCORANICUM:94:7-8:kommentar/r1.anchor: Fariġa, „mit etwas fertig werden“, und naṣiba, „sich mühen“, sind semantisch konträr

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p381/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p381/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p381/r1.claim: Qatāda says that after finishing prayer one should devote oneself to supplication.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p381/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله ﴿ فإذا فرغت فانصب ﴾ قال فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب في الدعاء

ALUSI-FULL:v30p171#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p171#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p171#2/r1.claim: When finished with an act of worship such as conveying revelation, the Prophet should exert himself in another act of worship, giving thanks for past favors and promised future gifts and leaving no time empty of worship.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p171#2/r1.anchor: أي من عبادة كتبليغ الوحي فانصب فاتعب في عبادة أخرى شكرا لما عددنا عليك من النعم السالفة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas, al-Dahhak, and Qatada say that after prayer one should devote oneself to supplication.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r2.anchor: وأخرج ابن جرير وغيره من طرق عن ابن عباس أنه قال أي إذا فرغت من الصلاة فانصب في الدعاء

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r3.claim: Ibn Masud says that after the obligatory prayers one should devote oneself to night vigil.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r3.anchor: وأخرج ابن المنذر عن ابن مسعود أي إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r4.speaker: الحسن، زيد بن أسلم
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r4.claim: Hasan and, similarly, Zayd ibn Aslam say that after a military campaign one should strive in worship; the objection that the surah is Meccan may be answered by positing a Medinan surah or verse, or a delayed ruling.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r4.anchor: وعن الحسن أي إذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r5.speaker: مجاهد
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r5.claim: Mujahid says that after finishing one's worldly affairs one should pray; in another report his view resembles Ibn Abbas's.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r5.anchor: وأخرج ابن نصر وجماعة عن مجاهد أي إذا فرغت من أسباب نفسك وفي لفظ من دنياك فصل

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r6.claim: Al-Alusi prefers the general worship sense and treats the specific prayer, supplication, and night vigil interpretations as examples; prayer and supplication may be singled out as central forms of worship.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r6.anchor: والأنسب حمل الآية على ما تقدم وأما قول ابن عباس ومن معه فهو تخصيص لبعض العبادات

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r7.speaker: مجاهد
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r7.claim: Mujahid's worldly-work reading draws on the common use of فراغ for freedom from worldly business, as in the saying to seize free time before becoming occupied; al-Alusi calls it the weakest view because it poorly fits the context and fa.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r7.anchor: وقول مجاهد نظر فيه إلى أن الفراغ أكثر ما يستعمل في الخلو عن الأشغال الدنيوية

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r8.speaker: عصام الدين
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r8.claim: Isam al-Din interprets the sequence as moving from one hardship to another in pursuit of two eases; al-Alusi says this is far from the ordinary sense.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r8.anchor: وقال عصام الدين لا نسب أن يراد فإذا فرغت من يسر فانصب بعسر آخر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r9.claim: The passage recommends filling one's time with worship or turning to worship once worldly affairs are done; Umar disliked idleness, and Sharik rebuked men for wrestling instead of productive work.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r9.anchor: وأشعرت الآية بأن اللائق يحال العبد أن يستغرق أوقاته بالعبادة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r10.speaker: أبو السمال
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r10.claim: Abu al-Sammal reads فرغت with a kasra on the rāʾ, a dialectal form that al-Zamakhshari calls inelegant.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r10.anchor: وقرأ أبو السمال فرغت بكسر الراء وهي لغة قال الزمخشري ليست بفصيحة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r11.speaker: قوم
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r11.claim: Some read فأنصب with a doubled open yāʾ from the form meaning to exert oneself, interpreted as turning wholly to another act of worship.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r11.anchor: وقرأ قوم فأنصب بشد الياء مفتوحة من الإنصاب

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r12.speaker: بعض الإمامية
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r12.claim: Some Imamis allege a reading with kasra on the ṣād and interpret it as appointing Ali to the imamate after prophethood; al-Alusi says the verse does not specify the person, and Sunnis can supply Abu Bakr based on the prayer-leadership report and the timing before the Prophet's death.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r12.anchor: ونسب إلى بعض الإمامية أنه قرأ فأنصب بكسر الصاد فقيل أي فإذا فرغت من النبوة فانصب عليا للأمامة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r13.speaker: الكشاف
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r13.claim: Al-Kashshaf says that if the Imami reading were valid, an anti-Ali reader could construe نصب as ordering hatred of Ali; al-Alusi finds this objection flawed.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r13.anchor: وقال في الكشاف لو صح ذلك للرافضي لصح للناصي أن يقرأ هكذا

ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r14.speaker: ابن عطية
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r14.claim: Ibn Atiyya calls the Imami reading anomalous and weak in meaning, not established from any recognized scholar.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p172/r14.anchor: وقال ابن عطية إن هذه القراءة شاذة ضعيفة المعنى لم تثبت عن عالم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r1.claim: The verb means to toil or exert oneself; naṣb means fatigue.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r1.anchor: أي فاتعب، والنصب: التعب، قال ابن عباس،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة والضحاك ومقاتل والكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r2.claim: When finished with the prescribed prayer, devote yourself to supplication and asking your Lord, who will answer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس، وقتادة، والضحاك، ومقاتل، والكلبي: فإذا فرغت من الصلاة المكتوبة فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r3.speaker: عبد الوهاب بن مجاهد عن أبيه
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r3.claim: After praying, strive in supplication and asking.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r3.anchor: وروى عبد الوهاب بن مجاهد عن أبيه قال: إذا صليت فاجتهد في الدعاء والمسألة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r4.claim: After the obligatory prayers, exert yourself in night prayer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r4.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r5.speaker: الشعبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r5.claim: After the testimony at the end of prayer, supplicate for worldly and afterlife needs.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r5.anchor: وقال الشعبي: إذا فرغت من التشهد فادع، لدنياك وآخرتك

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r6.speaker: الحسن وزيد بن أسلم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r6.claim: After finishing jihad against the enemy, devote yourself to worship of God.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن وزيد بن أسلم: إذا فرغت من جهاد عدوك فانصب في عبادة ربك

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r7.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r7.claim: When finished with worldly matters, devote yourself to worship and prayer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r7.anchor: وقال منصور عن مجاهد: إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فانصب في عبادة ربك وصل

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r8.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r8.claim: After completing the delivery of the message, seek forgiveness for yourself and the believers.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p466#2/r8.anchor: وقال حيان عن الكلبي: إذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة فانصب، أي: استغفر لذنبك وللمؤمنين

BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.claim: When finished with conveying the message, the Prophet should exert himself in worship to thank God for past blessings and promised future blessings; alternatively he should worship after warfare or pray then supplicate.
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r1.anchor: من التبيلغ. { فانصب } فاتعب في العبادة شكرا

BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.claim: A report likens reciting this sura to visiting the Prophet while distressed and relieving him.
BAYDAWI-FULL:94:7-8/r4.anchor: من قرأ سورة ألم نشرح فكأنما جاءني وأنا مغتم ففرج عني

BINTSHATI:v1p73/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r1.claim: Faragha means to become free for something; the future marker and both fa particles signal sequence as well as connection to what precedes.
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r1.anchor: فالفراغ متصل السبب بما سبقه من شرح الصدر ووضع الوزر ورفع الذكر

BINTSHATI:v1p73/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r2.claim: Nasab can mean exertion and fatigue or standing upright; both meanings are established in Arabic usage.
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r2.anchor: والنصب ملحوظ فيه معنى الجهد والتعب، والقيام أو الشخوص

BINTSHATI:v1p73/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r3.claim: Quranic examples distinguish upright setting, as of mountains, from exertion and fatigue, such as travel hardship or labor.
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r3.anchor: ومعنى التعب والجهد متعين في آيات:

BINTSHATI:v1p73/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r4.speaker: الراغب
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r4.claim: Al-Raghib appears to read fanṣab as assigning a specific allotted share, linking nasab to a fixed portion.
BINTSHATI:v1p73/r4.anchor: بأن النصب فيها من النصيب، أي القسم المنصوب الشاخص

BINTSHATI:v1p74/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r1.claim: The author chooses exertion and effort for fanṣab, supported by all Quranic uses of nasab; al-Nishaburi and Abduh agree, while al-Zamakhshari says diligence and persistence.
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r1.anchor: ونؤثر أن نلتفت إلى ما فيه كذلك من معنى الجهد والتعب

BINTSHATI:v1p74/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r2.claim: The verse deliberately leaves the activity unspecified, consistent with the Quran's practice of leaving open what context already indicates.
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r2.anchor: والآية لم تحدد مم يكون هذا الفراغ وفيم يكون النصب

BINTSHATI:v1p74/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r3.speaker: مفسرون
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r3.claim: Reported specifications include turning to prayer after finishing prayer, worship after jihad, or prayer after worldly work.
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r3.anchor: إذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء

BINTSHATI:v1p74/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r4.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r4.claim: Al-Tabari prefers a general instruction to turn all free time, whether from prayer, jihad, or worldly work, toward worship.
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r4.anchor: قول من قال إن الله تعالى أمر نبيه أن يجعل فراغه من كل ما كان مشتغلاً به

BINTSHATI:v1p74/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhshari, followed by Abduh, says that after finishing one act of worship Muhammad should follow it with another.
BINTSHATI:v1p74/r5.anchor: فإذا فرغت من عبادة فأتبعها أخرى

BINTSHATI:v1p75/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r1.claim: The fa links this command to the preceding assurance that relief follows hardship and that God fulfills His promise.
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r1.anchor: بسياق الآيات قبلها، بحكم وجود "الفاء" الرابطة للآية بما قبلها.

BINTSHATI:v1p75/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r2.claim: If finishing must be specified, it is the release from confusion, distress, and constriction; once relieved, Muhammad should devote himself to the burdens and struggle of his message.
BINTSHATI:v1p75/r2.anchor: هو فراغ اليسر بعد العسر، والراحة النفسية بعد الشدة والكرب، فلينصب المصطفى لتكاليف رسالته

BINTSHATI:v1p76/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p76/r6.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p76/r6.claim: The conjunction ties the exclusive desire for God to the preceding relief and promises, completing the surah's unified movement from distress to ease.
BINTSHATI:v1p76/r6.anchor: ووصل الآية بما قبلها، هو الذي يطرد به النسق وتتم وحدة السياق في السورة كلها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r2.speaker: الكشاف
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r2.claim: Al-Kashshaf explains the indefinite ease as a portion of the whole; a fresh statement can therefore mean a different portion without difficulty.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r2.anchor: وقال في الكشاف : وأما اليسر فمنكر متناول لبعض الجنس

BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r3.claim: Finishing the present ease may mean relief from jihad that is followed by another demanding duty, especially when people enter Islam in multitudes.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r3.anchor: من جهادك الذي أنت فيه في وقت المخاطبة بهذا الكلام

BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r4.claim: The completed task may instead be the weighty worship of receiving and bearing revelation, after which another duty remains.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r4.anchor: أو من العبادة الثقيلة العظيمة بسماع الوحي وتحمله

BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r5.claim: When one task is complete, the command is to labor in another act of worship, such as glorification, seeking forgiveness, or voluntary devotion.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r5.anchor: أي بالغ في التعب بعبادة أخرى من التسبيح والاستغفار

BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r8.claim: The ending points to renewed devotion after the Prophet finishes the Arab campaign, corresponding to eight years after the Hijra.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p466/r8.anchor: بعد انقضاء ما يوازي عدد آي هذه السورة من السنين بعد الهجرة , وهي ثمان

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r1.claim: When finished with prayer and tashahhud, the Prophet is to turn to God and ask for his need.
