DURR-FULL:v8p551/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} الآية قال: قال الله لرسوله: إذا فرغت من صلاتك وتشهدت

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r2.claim: He interprets finishing as turning to supplication and seeking one's requests from God.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r2.anchor: عن ابن مسعود {فإذا فرغت فانصب} إلى الدعاء {وإلى ربك فارغب} في المسألة

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r3.claim: Another report says finishing the bowing and prostrations completes prayer; one may make requests while seated.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r3.anchor: عن الضحاك قال: كان ابن مسعود يقول: أيما رجل أحدث في آخر صلاته فقد تمت صلاته

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r4.claim: He says that after finishing the obligatory prayers, one should stand for night prayer.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r4.anchor: عن ابن مسعود {فإذا فرغت فانصب} قال: إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r5.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r5.claim: He says that after sitting, one should strive in supplication and asking.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد {فإذا فرغت فانصب} قال: إذا جلست فاجتهد في الدعاء والمسألة

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r6.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r6.claim: Another explanation says that after finishing personal affairs, one should pray and direct one's desire to God.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r6.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {فإذا فرغت فانصب} قال: إذا فرغت من أسباب نفسك فصل {وإلى ربك فارغب}

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r7.claim: He says that after prayer the Prophet should devote himself to supplication and desire God in prayer.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r7.anchor: عن قتادة {فإذا فرغت فانصب} قال: إذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب في الدعاء

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r8.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r8.claim: He takes finishing to mean the obligatory prayer and turning to God in requests and supplication.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r8.anchor: عن الضحاك {فإذا فرغت} قال: من الصلاة المكتوبة {وإلى ربك فارغب} قال: في المسألة والدعاء

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r9.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r9.claim: Al-Hasan says that when the Prophet finishes a military expedition he should work hard in worship.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r9.anchor: قال الحسن: أمره إذا فرغ من غزوه أن يجتهد في العبادة

DURR-FULL:v8p551/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r10.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r10.claim: He says after finishing jihad, one should devote oneself to worship.
DURR-FULL:v8p551/r10.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم {فإذا فرغت فانصب} قال: إذا فرغت من الجهاد فتعبد

NASHR:v2p455/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r1.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p455/r1.claim: Ibn Mufliḥ’s example distinguishing letter names from letter sounds is his own elaboration; Aḥmad would not prefer a word merely because it has an extra letter.
NASHR:v2p455/r1.anchor: وهذا الذي ذكره ابن مفلح عن حرب ومثل به - تصرف منه، وإلا فلا يقول مثل الإمام أحمد

NASHR:v2p455/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r2.speaker: حبيب بن أبي عمرة
NASHR:v2p455/r2.claim: Ḥabīb ibn Abī ʿAmra says that when a person completes the Qur’an, an angel kisses him between the eyes; Aḥmad considered the report a subtle transmission of Sufyān and approved it.
NASHR:v2p455/r2.anchor: ثنا يحيى بن اليمان عن سفيان عن حبيب بن أبي عمرة قال: إذا ختم الرجل القرآن قبل الملك بين عينيه

NASHR:v2p455/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r3.speaker: محمد بن إسماعيل البخاري
NASHR:v2p455/r3.claim: Al-Bukhārī reportedly completed the Qur’an repeatedly in Ramadan: every three nights at dawn, daily by day, and each night at ifṭār, where he said each completion brings an answered supplication.
NASHR:v2p455/r3.anchor: كان محمد بن إسماعيل البخاري رحمه الله إذا كان أول ليلة من شهر رمضان يجتمع إليه أصحابه

NASHR:v2p455/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
NASHR:v2p455/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd is reported to say that whoever completes the Qur’an has an answered supplication.
NASHR:v2p455/r4.anchor: وروى أبو بكر بن داود في فضائل القرآن عن ابن مسعود: (من ختم القرآن فله دعوة مستجابة)

NASHR:v2p455/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r5.speaker: مجاهد
NASHR:v2p455/r5.claim: Mujāhid is reported to say that mercy descends when the Qur’an is completed.
NASHR:v2p455/r5.anchor: وعن مجاهد: (تنزل الرحمة عند ختم القرآن)

NASHR:v2p455/r6.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r6.speaker: مجاهد
NASHR:v2p455/r6.claim: Mujāhid is also reported to say that supplication is answered at the completion of the Qur’an.
NASHR:v2p455/r6.anchor: وعنه أيضا: (إن الدعاء مستجاب عند ختم القرآن)

NASHR:v2p455/r7.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p455/r7.speaker: أحمد بن حنبل
NASHR:v2p455/r7.claim: Aḥmad recommends making the completion in tarāwīḥ and raising hands in supplication before bowing.
NASHR:v2p455/r7.anchor: ونص الإمام أحمد على استحباب ذلك في صلاة التراويح، قال: حنبل سمعت أحمد يقول في ختم القرآن:

NASHR:v2p456/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r1.speaker: أحمد بن حنبل
NASHR:v2p456/r1.claim: Aḥmad instructs the reader to raise hands before bowing after the final sūra, supplicate for those present, and prolong the standing; the prayer may ask for anything.
NASHR:v2p456/r1.anchor: إذا فرغت من آخر القرآن فارفع يديك قبل أن تركع وادع بنا، ونحن في الصلاة وأطل القيام.

NASHR:v2p456/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r2.speaker: الفضل بن زياد
NASHR:v2p456/r2.claim: Al-Faḍl ibn Ziyād says he followed Aḥmad’s instruction to supplicate with raised hands while Aḥmad stood behind him and prayed.
NASHR:v2p456/r2.anchor: وقال الفضل بن زياد سألت أبا عبد الله يعني أحمد بن حنبل فقلت: أختم القرآن أجعله في التراويح،

NASHR:v2p456/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r3.speaker: عباس بن عبد العظيم
NASHR:v2p456/r3.claim: Makkans practiced raising hands at the completion, with Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna among them; ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm saw the practice in Basra and Mecca, and reports were also known in Medina and from ʿUthmān.
NASHR:v2p456/r3.anchor: قال: رأيت أهل مكة يفعلون، وكان سفيان بن عيينة يفعله معهم بمكة. قال عباس بن عبد العظيم

NASHR:v2p456/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r4.speaker: قتادة
NASHR:v2p456/r4.claim: Qatāda reports that Ibn ʿAbbās assigned watchers to a man reading through the Qur’an for companions, then came to witness the completion.
NASHR:v2p456/r4.anchor: وروينا في كتاب فضائل القرآن لأبي عبيد عن قتادة قال: كان بالمدينة رجل يقرأ القرآن

NASHR:v2p456/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r5.speaker: النووي
NASHR:v2p456/r5.claim: Al-Nawawī strongly recommends supplication after Qur’an recitation and urges persistent, comprehensive prayers focused on the afterlife, Muslims, and their leaders.
NASHR:v2p456/r5.anchor: قال الإمام النووي: يستحب الدعاء بعد قراءة القرآن استحبابا يتأكد تأكيدا شديدا

NASHR:v2p456/r6.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r6.speaker: بعض شيوخنا
NASHR:v2p456/r6.claim: Some of Ibn al-Jazarī’s teachers preferred that the reader who completed the Qur’an be the one to supplicate.
NASHR:v2p456/r6.anchor: وكان بعض شيوخنا يختار أن القارئ عليه إذا ختم - هو الذي يدعو؛ لظاهر هذا الحديث.

NASHR:v2p456/r7.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r7.speaker: سائر من أدركناهم
NASHR:v2p456/r7.claim: Most scholars known to Ibn al-Jazarī had the shaykh or a person sought for blessing make the supplication at the completion.
NASHR:v2p456/r7.anchor: وسائر من أدركناهم غيره يدعو الشيخ، أو من يلتمس بركته من حاضري الختم.

NASHR:v2p456/r8.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r8.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p456/r8.claim: The difference is easy to accept because supplicator and respondent are one; the source illustrates this with God’s answer to Moses and Aaron and reports that Aaron said amen.
NASHR:v2p456/r8.anchor: والأمر في هذا سهل إذ الداعي والمؤمن واحد. قال الله تعالى: قد أجيبت دعوتكما

NASHR:v2p456/r9.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p456/r9.speaker: أنس بن مالك
NASHR:v2p456/r9.claim: Anas ibn Mālik gathered his family and neighbors at a Qur’an completion, though the excerpt breaks off after saying he hoped for something.
NASHR:v2p456/r9.anchor: وكان أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه يجمع أهله وجيرانه عند الختم رجاء

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r1.claim: After listing God's favors and promise of ease, the Prophet is told to persist in worship when he finishes one task, without slackening.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r1.anchor: ولما عدد تعالى نعمه السابقة عليه

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r2.claim: Ibn Masʿūd says that after an obligatory duty, the Prophet should engage in supererogatory worship.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r2.anchor: قال ابن مسعود : { فإذا فرغت } من فرضك

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿūd also interprets the command as performing night prayer.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r3.anchor: قال ابن مسعود : { فإذا فرغت } من فرضك ،   { فانصب } في التنفل عبادة لربك . وقال أيضاً : { فانصب } في قيام الليل

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r4.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r4.claim: Mujāhid says that when worldly work ends, the Prophet should devote himself to worship.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r4.anchor: وقال مجاهد : قال { فإذا فرغت } من شغل دنياك

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r5.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Qatādah say that after prayer the Prophet should devote himself to supplication.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r5.anchor: وقال ابن عباس وقتادة : { فإذا فرغت } من الصلاة ،   { فانصب } في الدعاء

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r6.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan says that after jihad the Prophet should devote himself to worship; Abū Ḥayyān objects that jihad was prescribed in Medina.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن : { فإذا فرغت } من الجهاد ،   { فانصب } في العبادة . ويعترض قوله هذا بأن الجهاد فرض بالمدينة

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r7.speaker: الجمهور وأبو السمال
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r7.claim: The majority read faraghta with fatḥa on rāʾ; Abū al-Sammāl uses kasra as a dialect.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r7.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور : { فرغت } بفتح الراء ؛ وأبو السمال : بكسرها

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī calls the kasra form non-eloquent.

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r9.speaker: الجمهور وقوم
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r9.claim: The majority read fanṣab with a quiescent bāʾ and no gemination; another group doubles it with fatḥa, from anṣāb.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r9.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور : { فانصب } بسكون الباء خفيفة ،   وقوم : بشدها مفتوحة

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r10.speaker: آخرون من الإمامية
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r10.claim: Some Imāmī readers read fanṣib with kasra on ṣād, meaning appoint a successor after finishing the message.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r10.anchor: وقرأ آخرون من الإمامية : فانصب بكسر الصاد بمعنى

ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r11.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyyah calls the Imāmī reading anomalous and weak in meaning, and says it is not established from a scholar.
ABUHAYYAN:94:7/r11.anchor: قال ابن عطية : وهي قراءة شاذة ضعيفة المعنى لم تثبت عن عالم

ALUSI:94:7/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:7/r1.claim: When the Prophet finishes one act of worship, such as conveying revelation, he should exert himself in another as thanks for past blessings and promised favors, leaving no time without worship.
ALUSI:94:7/r1.anchor: فاتعب في عبادة أخرى شكراً لما عددنا عليك من النعم السالفة

ALUSI:94:8/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI:94:8/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says that after finishing prayer, one should exert oneself in supplication; al-Dahhak and Qatada are also reported similarly.
ALUSI:94:8/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس أنه قال أي إذا فرغت من لصلاة

ALUSI:94:8/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
ALUSI:94:8/r3.claim: Ibn Masud says that after finishing obligatory prayers, one should exert oneself in night prayer.
ALUSI:94:8/r3.anchor: عن ابن مسعود أي إذا فرغت من الفرائض

ALUSI:94:8/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r4.speaker: الحسن وزيد بن أسلم
ALUSI:94:8/r4.claim: Al-Hasan interprets finishing as completing a campaign, followed by striving in worship; Zayd ibn Aslam is reported to share this view.
ALUSI:94:8/r4.anchor: عن الحسن أي إذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة

ALUSI:94:8/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r5.speaker: مجاهد
ALUSI:94:8/r5.claim: Mujahid says that when one finishes personal or worldly affairs, one should pray; another report from him resembles Ibn Abbas's interpretation.
ALUSI:94:8/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد أي إذا فرغت من أسباب نفسك وفي لقظ من دنياك فصل

ALUSI:94:8/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r6.claim: Al-Ālūsī prefers the general reading of finishing one worship and beginning another; the named practices specify examples, not limits on the verse.
ALUSI:94:8/r6.anchor: والأنسب حمل الآية على ما تقدم

ALUSI:94:8/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r7.claim: The instruction implies devoting one's time to worship or turning to it after worldly work; idleness or irrelevant occupation shows foolish judgment and heedlessness.
ALUSI:94:8/r7.anchor: أن اللائق بحال العبد أن يستغرق أوقاته بالعبادة أو بأن يفرغ إلى العبادة

ALUSI:94:8/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r8.speaker: عمر
ALUSI:94:8/r8.claim: Umar says he dislikes seeing anyone idle and without useful work for worldly or afterlife concerns.
ALUSI:94:8/r8.anchor: أني لأكره أن أرى أحدكم فارغاً سبهللا لا في عمل دنياه ولا في عمل آخرته

ALUSI:94:8/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r9.speaker: شريك
ALUSI:94:8/r9.claim: Sharik reportedly saw two men wrestling and asked what had happened to these idle men, illustrating the censure of useless idleness.

ALUSI:94:8/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r10.speaker: أبو السمال
ALUSI:94:8/r10.claim: Abu al-Sammal reads faraghta with kasra on the rā, a dialect form that al-Zamakhshari calls inelegant.

ALUSI:94:8/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r11.speaker: قوم
ALUSI:94:8/r11.claim: A group reads fansab with a doubled, open bā, from inṣibāb; the meaning is to turn wholly toward another worship.
ALUSI:94:8/r11.anchor: بشد الباء مفتوحة من الانصباب والمراد فتوجه إلى عبادة

ALUSI:94:8/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r12.speaker: بعض الإمامية
ALUSI:94:8/r12.claim: A reading attributed to some Imamiyya has fansib with kasra on ṣād and takes the object as Ali: after prophethood, appoint him to the imamate.
ALUSI:94:8/r12.anchor: انه قرأ فانصب بكسر الصاد فقيل أي فإذا فرغت من النبوة

ALUSI:94:8/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r13.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r13.claim: Al-Ālūsī notes that the verse names no particular object to appoint, so a Sunni could equally supply Abu Bakr; the verse alone does not establish the Imamiyya claim.
ALUSI:94:8/r13.anchor: ليس في الآية دليل على خصوصية المفعول فللسنى أن يقدره أبا بكر

ALUSI:94:8/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r14.speaker: السني
ALUSI:94:8/r14.claim: In response to the Imamiyya appeal to Ghadir Khumm, the Sunni denies that it proves appointment or is authentic as transmitted by the Imamiyya.
ALUSI:94:8/r14.anchor: منع السني دلالته على ما ثبت عنده على النصب وصحته

ALUSI:94:8/r15.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r15.speaker: السني
ALUSI:94:8/r15.claim: The Sunni supports appointing Abu Bakr with the Prophet's instruction that he lead people in prayer, which better fits the completion of his mission in the final illness.
ALUSI:94:8/r15.anchor: فللسنى أن يقدره أبا بكر رضي الله تعالى عنه

ALUSI:94:8/r16.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r16.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r16.claim: If the Imamiyya reply that the verse means finishing pilgrimage and appointing Ali, Al-Ālūsī objects that the sūra is Meccan.

ALUSI:94:8/r17.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r17.speaker: الزمخشري
ALUSI:94:8/r17.claim: Al-Zamakhshari argues that if the Imamiyya reading were sound, an anti-Ali partisan could read it as an order to hate Ali; Al-Ālūsī finds this objection flawed.
ALUSI:94:8/r17.anchor: وقال في الكشاف لو صح ذلك للرافضي لصح للناصبي

ALUSI:94:8/r18.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r18.speaker: بعض الناس
ALUSI:94:8/r18.claim: Others supply khalīfa, caliph, as the omitted object; Al-Ālūsī says little turns on this proposal.
ALUSI:94:8/r18.anchor: ومن الناس من قدر المفعول خليفة والأمر فيه هين

ALUSI:94:8/r19.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r19.speaker: ابن عطية
ALUSI:94:8/r19.claim: Ibn Atiyya calls the Imamiyya reading anomalous and weak in meaning, and says it has not been established from a scholar.
ALUSI:94:8/r19.anchor: أن هذه القراءة شاذة ضعيفة المعنى لم تثبت عن عالم

ALUSI:94:8/r20.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r20.speaker: عصام الدين
ALUSI:94:8/r20.claim: Isam al-Din proposes finishing one ease and exerting under another hardship to seek two eases, then aspiring to God; Al-Ālūsī rejects this as contrary to the plain sense.
ALUSI:94:8/r20.anchor: وقال عصام الدين لا نسب ان يراد فإذا فرغت من يسر

ALUSI:94:8/r21.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r21.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r21.claim: The Prophet's saying about returning from the lesser to the greater jihad is invoked for Hasan's interpretation, but its fit is questioned because the sūra is Meccan and jihad followed migration; a Medinan sūra or verse, or delayed ruling, could be posited.
ALUSI:94:8/r21.anchor: وهو قريب إلا أنه قيل عليه أن السورة مكية والأمر بالجهاد بعد الهجرة

ALUSI:94:8/r22.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r22.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r22.claim: Mujahid's worldly-affairs interpretation fits the common use of farāgh for release from worldly occupations and the saying to use free time before busyness, but is the weakest because context and fa point elsewhere.
ALUSI:94:8/r22.anchor: أن الفراغ أكثر ما يستعمل في الخلو عن الأشغال الدنيوية

ALUSI:94:8/r23.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r23.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r23.claim: The causal fa favors the general reading that each completed worship is followed by another.
ALUSI:94:8/r23.anchor: وهو أضعف الأقوال لبعده عما يقتضيه السياق وتؤذن به الفاء

ALUSI:94:8/r24.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r24.speaker: زيد بن علي وابن أبي عبلة
ALUSI:94:8/r24.claim: Zayd ibn Ali and Ibn Abi Abla read faraghib, an imperative from the doubled verb raghiba, meaning to urge people to seek what God has.
ALUSI:94:8/r24.anchor: وقرأ زيد بن علي وابن أبي عبلة فرغب أمر من رغب بشد الغين

ALUSI:94:8/r25.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r25.speaker: النبي
ALUSI:94:8/r25.claim: The saying 'we returned from the lesser jihad to the greater jihad' is cited in connection with al-Hasan's reading; the source notes the chronology problem but reports possible answers.
ALUSI:94:8/r25.anchor: رجعنا من الجهاد الأصغر إلى الجهاد الأكبر

ALUSI:94:8/r26.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:94:8/r26.speaker: author
ALUSI:94:8/r26.claim: Isam al-Din's expanded proposal says not to bear worldly hardship for two worldly eases, but to bear hardship seeking the Lord and nearness for both eases; Al-Ālūsī says no sound mind derives this from the wording.
ALUSI:94:8/r26.anchor: لا تتحمل عسر الدنيا طمعاً في يسرين فيها بل تحمل عسر طلب الرب وقربه

BAGHAWI:94:7/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:94:7/r1.claim: Inṣab means exert yourself; naṣab means toil or fatigue.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r1.anchor: { فإذا فرغت فانصب } أي فاتعب ، والنصب : التعب

BAGHAWI:94:7/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r2.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة والضحاك ومقاتل والكلبي
BAGHAWI:94:7/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas, Qatada, al-Dahhak, Muqatil, and al-Kalbi say that after the obligatory prayer, the Prophet should devote himself to supplication and petitioning his Lord, who will grant his request.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس ، وقتادة ، والضحاك ، ومقاتل ، والكلبي : فإذا فرغت من الصلاة المكتوبة فانصب إلى ربك في الدعاء

BAGHAWI:94:7/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r3.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:94:7/r3.claim: Mujahid, as reported by his father through ʿAbd al-Wahhab, says that after prayer one should strive in supplication and petition.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r3.anchor: وروى عبد الوهاب عن مجاهد عن أبيه قال : إذا صليت فاجتهد في الدعاء والمسألة

BAGHAWI:94:7/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
BAGHAWI:94:7/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿud says that after finishing the obligatory duties one should exert oneself in night prayer.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r4.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

BAGHAWI:94:7/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r5.speaker: الشعبي
BAGHAWI:94:7/r5.claim: Al-Shaʿbi says that after the tashahhud one should pray for this world and the Hereafter.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r5.anchor: وقال الشعبي : إذا فرغت من التشهد فادع لدنياك وآخرتك

BAGHAWI:94:7/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r6.speaker: الحسن وزيد بن أسلم
BAGHAWI:94:7/r6.claim: Al-Hasan and Zayd ibn Aslam say that after finishing the struggle against the enemy one should exert oneself in worship of the Lord.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن وزيد بن أسلم : إذا فرغت من جهاد عدوك فانصب في عبادة ربك

BAGHAWI:94:7/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r7.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:94:7/r7.claim: Mujahid, reported by Mansur, says that after finishing worldly affairs one should exert oneself in worship and prayer.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r7.anchor: وقال منصور عن مجاهد : إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فانصب في عبادة ربك وصل

BAGHAWI:94:7/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:94:7/r8.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI:94:7/r8.claim: Al-Kalbi, reported by Hayyan, says that after conveying the message one should strive by seeking forgiveness for one's own sin and for the believers.
BAGHAWI:94:7/r8.anchor: وقال حيان عن الكلبي : إذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة فانصب ، أي : استغفر لذنبك وللمؤمنين

BAYDAWI:94:7/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:94:7/r1.claim: After finishing the conveyance, strive in worship in gratitude for past blessings and promised future blessings.
BAYDAWI:94:7/r1.anchor: فإذا فرغت من التبليغ فانصب فاتعب في العبادة شكرا لما عددنا عليك من النعم السالفة

BAYDAWI:94:7/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:94:7/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:94:7/r2.claim: Alternatively, when finished with battle, strive in worship.
BAYDAWI:94:7/r2.anchor: وقيل : إذا فرغت من الغزو فانصب في العبادة ،

BAYDAWI:94:7/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:94:7/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:94:7/r3.claim: Another view is to strive in supplication after finishing prayer.
BAYDAWI:94:7/r3.anchor: أو فإذا فرغت من الصلاة فانصب بالدعاء

BIQAI:94:7/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:7/r1.claim: The favors and relief God grants call for strenuous acts of gratitude, and the grateful servant is promised further increase.
BIQAI:94:7/r1.anchor: ولما علم من هذا أن المواد تكون بحسب الأوراد الشداد لما على الممدود من الشكر ، ولما علم للشاكر من الوعد بالمزيد

BIQAI:94:7/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:7/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:7/r2.claim: One reading is that, after relief from the particular jihad underway when this address came, the Prophet should turn to further effort; the surrounding situation could still bring hardship.
BIQAI:94:7/r2.anchor: أي بما آتاك من اليسر يسر من جهادك الذي أنت فيه في وقت المخاطبة بهذا الكلام مما يوجب عسراً في المآل أو الحال

BIQAI:94:7/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:7/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:7/r3.claim: Another possible completion is the burdensome worship of hearing and bearing revelation.
BIQAI:94:7/r3.anchor: أو من العبادة الثقيلة العظيمة بسماع الوحي وتحمله

BIQAI:94:7/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:7/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:7/r4.claim: The phrase may also mean finishing the task for which God promised to make things easy.
BIQAI:94:7/r4.anchor: أو من الغرض بالتيسير الذي بشرناك به

BIQAI:94:7/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:94:7/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI:94:7/r5.claim: After finishing, persist in another act of worship such as glorification and seeking forgiveness, or in voluntary prayer for the one who bestowed the favor.
BIQAI:94:7/r5.anchor: أي بالغ في التعب بعبادة أخرى من التسبيح والاستغفار ، أو النفل لمن أولاك هذا المعروف

DURR:94:7/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:94:7/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says that after finishing prayer, the Prophet should exert himself in supplication, ask God, and turn to Him.
DURR:94:7/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فإذا فرغت فانصب } الآية قال : إذا فرغت من الصلاة فانصب في الدعاء

DURR:94:7/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:94:7/r2.claim: Another Ibn Abbas report specifies finishing the prayer and tashahhud, then turning to God to ask for one's need.
DURR:94:7/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فإذا فرغت فانصب } الآية ، قال : قال الله لرسوله : إذا فرغت من صلاتك وتشهدت

DURR:94:7/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR:94:7/r3.claim: Ibn Mas'ud glosses exertion as supplication and turning to the Lord as asking.
DURR:94:7/r3.anchor: عن ابن مسعود { فإذا فرغت فانصب } إلى الدعاء { وإلى ربك فارغب } في المسألة

DURR:94:7/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR:94:7/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak transmits Ibn Mas'ud's view that a person's prayer is complete if ritual impurity occurs at its end; finishing means after bowing and prostration, then asking God while seated.
DURR:94:7/r4.anchor: عن الضحاك قال : كان ابن مسعود يقول : أيما رجل أحدث في آخر صلاته ، فقد تمت صلاته

DURR:94:7/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR:94:7/r5.claim: Ibn Mas'ud says that after completing the obligatory prayers one should exert oneself in night prayer.
DURR:94:7/r5.anchor: عن ابن مسعود { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

DURR:94:7/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r6.speaker: مجاهد
DURR:94:7/r6.claim: Mujahid says that once seated, one should strive in supplication and petition.
DURR:94:7/r6.anchor: عن مجاهد { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا جلست فاجتهد في الدعاء والمسألة

DURR:94:7/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r7.speaker: مجاهد
DURR:94:7/r7.claim: Mujahid says that after one's personal affairs are finished, one should pray and make one's desire solely toward the Lord.
DURR:94:7/r7.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله : { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا فرغت من أسباب نفسك فصل { وإلى ربك فارغب }

DURR:94:7/r8.speaker: قتادة
DURR:94:7/r8.claim: Qatada says that after finishing prayer one should exert oneself in supplication.
DURR:94:7/r8.anchor: عن قتادة { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب في الدعاء

DURR:94:7/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r9.speaker: الضحاك
DURR:94:7/r9.claim: Al-Dahhak says the verse means to finish the obligatory prayer and then turn to God with requests and supplication.
DURR:94:7/r9.anchor: عن الضحاك { فإذا فرغت } قال : من الصلاة المكتوبة { وإلى ربك فارغب } قال : في المسألة والدعاء

DURR:94:7/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r10.speaker: قتادة
DURR:94:7/r10.claim: Qatada says that after prayer the Prophet was commanded to turn to God in supplication; al-Hasan instead says after a campaign he should strive in worship.
DURR:94:7/r10.anchor: عن قتادة { فإذا فرغت فانصب وإلى ربك فارغب } قال : أمره إذا فرغ من الصلاة أن يرغب في الدعاء إلى ربه

DURR:94:7/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:7/r11.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
DURR:94:7/r11.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says that after finishing jihad, one should devote oneself to worship.
DURR:94:7/r11.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا فرغت من الجهاد فتعبد

DURR:94:8/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:94:8/r1.speaker: ابن عباس

DURR:94:8/r11.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
DURR:94:8/r11.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says that after finishing jihad, one should devote oneself to worship.
DURR:94:8/r11.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم { فإذا فرغت فانصب } قال : إذا فرغت من الجهاد فتعبد

IBNASHUR:94:7/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r1.claim: The instruction follows the reminders of care, promise, and the easing of difficult obedience, especially conveying the message without fatigue or impatience.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r1.anchor: تفريع على ما تقرر من التذكير باللطف والعناية ووعده وبتيسير ما هو عسير عليه في طاعته التي أعظمها تبليغ الرسالة دون مَلَل ولا ضجر

IBNASHUR:94:7/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r2.claim: Faragh literally describes an empty container; the verb implies it was full, and applying it to a person metaphorically means completing an assigned task.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r2.anchor: والفراغ :  خلو باطن الظرف أو الإناء لأن شأنه أن يظرف فيه

IBNASHUR:94:7/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r3.claim: The omitted object is understood from context as the Prophet's known duties: when one important task is complete, undertake another so that all his time is filled with important work.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r3.anchor: فالمعنى إذا أتممت عملاً من مهام الأعمال فأقبل على عمل آخر بحيث يعمر أوقاته كلها بالأعمال العظيمة

IBNASHUR:94:7/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR:94:7/r4.claim: The Prophet is quoted on returning from a campaign as saying that they had returned from the lesser jihad to the greater jihad; Ibn Ashur uses it to illustrate taking up a new task.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r4.anchor: ومن هنا قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عند قفوله من إحدى غزواته :  « رجعنا من الجهاد الأصغر إلى الجهاد الأكبر »

IBNASHUR:94:7/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r5.speaker: السلف
IBNASHUR:94:7/r5.claim: Early commentators differed in examples of what the Prophet had finished; Ibn Ashur says these are illustrative, while the omitted object generically covers important work and requires prioritization when tasks cannot coincide.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r5.anchor: واختلفت أقوال المفسرين من السلف في تعيين المفروغ منه ،  وإنما هو اختلاف في الأمثلة فحذف المتعلق هنا لقصد العموم

IBNASHUR:94:7/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r6.claim: This general ordering of tasks also appears in the command to maintain prayer while conducting jihad, with prayer performed by alternating groups.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r6.anchor: كما أقر الله بأداء الصلاة مع الشغل بالجهاد بقوله :  { وإذا كنت فيهم فأقمت لهم الصلاة فلتقم طائفة منهم معك } إلى قوله :  { كتاباً موقوتاً }

IBNASHUR:94:7/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r7.claim: The instruction extends to possible personal duties such as night prayer and to jihad when Muslims are strong, as well as managing the community's affairs.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r7.anchor: وهذا الحكم ينسحب على كل عمل ممكن من أعماله الخاصة به مثل قيام الليل والجهاد عند تقوي المسلمين وتدبير أمور الأمة

IBNASHUR:94:7/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:7/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:7/r8.claim: Placing the completion clause first stresses that each task should follow the previous one, and the verse is a concise statement rich in meaning.
IBNASHUR:94:7/r8.anchor: وتقديم { فإذا فرغت } على { فانصب } للاهتمام بتعليق العمل بوقت الفراغ من غيره لتتعاقب الأعمال . وهذه الآية من جوامع الكلم القرآنية

IBNASHUR:94:8/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:8/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:8/r7.claim: The fāʾ links the verbs because fronting their complements implies restriction and thereby a conditional sense; this is common, as in the cited verses.
IBNASHUR:94:8/r7.anchor: رابطة للفعل لأن تقديم المعمول يتضمن معنى الاشتراط والتقييد فإن تقديم المعمول لما أفاد الاختصاص نشأ منه معنى الاشتراط

IBNASHUR:94:8/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:8/r9.speaker: الطيبي
IBNASHUR:94:8/r9.claim: Al-Ṭībī, citing al-Sayyid’s A Amālī (Ibn al-Shajarī), calls the combination of fāʾ and wāw here one of the most astonishing expressions because fāʾ has other usual syntactic roles.
IBNASHUR:94:8/r9.anchor: وذكر الطيبي عن « أمالي السيد » ( يعني ابن الشجري ) أن اجتماع الفاء والواو هنا من أعجب كلامهم

IBNASHUR:94:8/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:94:8/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:94:8/r10.claim: Once the restrictive force of the fronted complement is understood as conditional, there is no reason for al-Ṭībī’s puzzlement about the fāʾ and wāw.
IBNASHUR:94:8/r10.anchor: ولا يبقى تعجب بعد ما قررناه

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r1.claim: When the Prophet finishes one task of prophethood or worship, he should apply himself to another.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r1.anchor: ثم أمر نبيه عليه الصلاة والسلام إذا فرغ من شغل من أشغال النبوة والعبادة أن ينصب في آخر

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r2.claim: Naṣab means toil; the command is to persist in what he was ordered to do without slackening.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r2.anchor: والنصب : التعب ،   فالمعنى أن يدأب على ما أمر به ولا يفتر

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says that after completing the obligatory duty, one should exert oneself in voluntary worship of the Lord.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r3.anchor: وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : المعنى : فإذا فرغت من فرضك فانصب في التنفل عبادة لربك

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd takes the command as exerting oneself in the night vigil.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r4.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود : فانصب في قيام الليل

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r5.speaker: مجاهد
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r5.claim: Mujāhid says that after finishing worldly work, one should exert oneself in worship of the Lord.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r5.anchor: وعن مجاهد : فإذا فرغت من شغل دنياك فانصب في عبادة ربك

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r6.speaker: قيل
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r6.claim: One view says that after the prayer cycles, one should sit for tashahhud and exert oneself in supplication.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r6.anchor: وقيل : المعنى : إذا فرغت من الركعات فاجلس في التشهد وانصب في الدعاء

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r7.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Qatāda say that after completing worship, one should exert oneself in supplication.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r7.anchor: وقال ابن عباس وقتادة : معنى الكلام : فإذا فرغت من العبادة فانصب في الدعاء

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r8.speaker: الحسن بن أبي الحسن
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r8.claim: Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī says that after finishing jihad, one should exert oneself in worship.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r8.anchor: وقال الحسن بن أبي الحسن : فإذا فرغت من الجهاد فانصب في العبادة

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r9.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya objects to the jihad interpretation because jihad became obligatory in Medina.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r9.anchor: ويعترض هذا التأويل بأن الجهاد فرض بالمدينة

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r10.speaker: أبو السمال
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r10.claim: Abū al-Sammāl reads faraghta with kasra on the rāʾ, a dialect form.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r10.anchor: وقرأ أبو السمال ( فرغت ) بكسر الراء

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r11.speaker: قوم
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r11.claim: Some read the bāʾ doubled and open, construing the phrase as heading to Medina after finishing jihad.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r11.anchor: وقرأ قوم ( فانصب ) بشد الباء وفتحها

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r12.speaker: النقاش
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r12.claim: Al-Naqqāsh mentions that variant to flag it as erroneous.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r12.anchor: ذكرها النقاش منبها على أنها خطأ

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r13.speaker: آخرون من الإمامية
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r13.claim: Some Imāmīs read the ṣād with kasra to mean appoint a successor after the prophetic mission; Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls it anomalous, weak in meaning, and unattested from a scholar.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r13.anchor: وقرأ آخرون من الإمامية : ( فانصب ) بكسر الصاد

IBNATIYYA:94:7/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r14.speaker: شريح
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r14.claim: Shurayḥ passed two men wrestling, said this was not what the command about free time meant, and recited the verse.
IBNATIYYA:94:7/r14.anchor: ومر شريح على رجلين يصطرعان فقال : ليس بهذا أمر الفراغ ،   تلا هذه الآية

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r1.claim: When worldly duties are finished and their distractions set aside, devote yourself energetically and wholeheartedly to worship, with sincere intention and desire directed to God.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r1.anchor: أي : إذا فرغت من أمور الدنيا وأشغالها وقطعت علائقها ، فانصب في العبادة ، وقم إليها نشيطا فارغ البال ، وأخلص لربك النية والرغبة .

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r2.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r2.claim: The Prophet said not to pray when food is present or while one is resisting the two bodily calls of nature; Muslim transmits this report from ʿĀʾisha.

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r3.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r3.claim: The Prophet said that when the prayer is called and dinner is served, diners should begin with the meal; al-Bukhārī transmits it from ʿĀʾisha.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r3.anchor: إذا أقيمت الصلاة وحضر العشاء ،   فابدءوا

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r4.claim: Mujāhid says that after completing worldly affairs and standing for prayer, one should exert oneself for one's Lord.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r4.anchor: قال مجاهد في هذه الآية : إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فقمت إلى الصلاة ، فانصب لربك

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r5.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r5.claim: In another version, Mujāhid says that when one stands to pray, one should exert oneself in one's need.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r5.anchor: وفي رواية عنه : إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصب في حاجتك

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r6.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عياض
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r6.claim: Ibn Masʿūd explains this as finishing the obligatory prayers and then devoting oneself to night vigil; Ibn ʿAyyāḍ gives a similar view.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r6.anchor: وعن ابن مسعود : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل . وعن ابن عياض نحوه .

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, through ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa, interprets the instruction as applying oneself in supplication.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r8.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طلحة ، عن ابن عباس : { فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ } يعني : في الدعاء .

IBNKATHIR:94:7/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r9.speaker: زيد بن أسلم والضحاك
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r9.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam and al-Ḍaḥḥāk say that after jihad one should devote oneself to worship and turn one's desire to God.
IBNKATHIR:94:7/r9.anchor: وقال زيد بن أسلم ، والضحاك : { فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ } أي : من الجهاد { فَانْصَبْ } أي : في العبادة .

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r1.speaker: author

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r3.anchor: إذا أقيمت الصلاة وحضر العشاء ،   فابدءوا

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r4.speaker: مجاهد

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r4.anchor: قال مجاهد في هذه الآية : إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا فقمت إلى الصلاة ، فانصب لربك

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r5.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r5.claim: In another version, Mujāhid says that when one stands to pray, one should exert oneself in one's need.
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r5.anchor: وفي رواية عنه : إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصب في حاجتك

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r6.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عياض
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r6.claim: Ibn Masʿūd explains this as finishing the obligatory prayers and then devoting oneself to night vigil; Ibn ʿAyyāḍ gives a similar view.
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r6.anchor: وعن ابن مسعود : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل . وعن ابن عياض نحوه .

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, through ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa, interprets the instruction as applying oneself in supplication.
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r8.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طلحة ، عن ابن عباس : { فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ } يعني : في الدعاء .

IBNKATHIR:94:8/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r9.speaker: زيد بن أسلم والضحاك
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r9.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam and al-Ḍaḥḥāk say that after jihad one should devote oneself to worship and turn one's desire to God.
IBNKATHIR:94:8/r9.anchor: وقال زيد بن أسلم ، والضحاك : { فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ } أي : من الجهاد { فَانْصَبْ } أي : في العبادة .

KASHSHAF:94:7/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:94:7/r1.claim: After recounting past favors and future promises, God urges gratitude and strenuous worship.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r1.anchor: قلت : لما عدد عليه نعمه السالفة ووعده الآنفة ، بعثه على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة والنصب فيها ،

KASHSHAF:94:7/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:94:7/r2.claim: The Prophet should keep worship continuous, following one act with another and leaving no time empty of worship.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r2.anchor: وأن يواصل بين بعضها وبعض ، ويتابع ويحرص على أن لا يخلي وقتاً من أوقاته منها ،

KASHSHAF:94:7/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF:94:7/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās interprets it as finishing prayer and then striving in supplication.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r3.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فاجتهد في الدعاء .

KASHSHAF:94:7/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r4.speaker: الحسن
KASHSHAF:94:7/r4.claim: Al-Ḥasan interprets it as finishing a military campaign and then striving in worship.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r4.anchor: وعن الحسن : فإذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة .

KASHSHAF:94:7/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r5.speaker: مجاهد
KASHSHAF:94:7/r5.claim: Mujāhid interprets it as finishing worldly affairs and then devoting oneself to prayer.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r5.anchor: وعن مجاهد : فإذا فرغت من دنياك فانصب في صلاتك .

KASHSHAF:94:7/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r6.speaker: الشعبي
KASHSHAF:94:7/r6.claim: Al-Shaʿbī saw a man carrying a stone and remarked that this was not what an idle person had been commanded to do.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r6.anchor: وعن الشعبي : أنه رأى رجلاً يشيل حجراً فقال : ليس بهذا أمر الفارغ ،

KASHSHAF:94:7/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:94:7/r7.claim: Being idle without useful work, or occupied with what does not benefit one’s religion or worldly life, reflects poor judgment, dullness, and heedlessness.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r7.anchor: وقعود الرجل فارغاً من غير شغل أو اشتغاله بما لا يعينه في دينه أو دنياه : من سفه الرأي

KASHSHAF:94:7/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r8.speaker: عمر
KASHSHAF:94:7/r8.claim: ʿUmar says he dislikes seeing anyone idle, doing no work for either this world or the next.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r8.anchor: ولقد قال عمر رضي الله عنه : إني لأكره أن أرى أحدكم فارغاً سهللاً لا في عمل دنيا ولا في عمل آخرة

KASHSHAF:94:7/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r9.speaker: أبو السمال
KASHSHAF:94:7/r9.claim: Abū al-Sammāl reads “faraghta” with rāʾ kasra; al-Zamakhsharī says this form is not eloquent.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r9.anchor: وقرأ أبو السّمّال : فرغت - بكسر الراء - وليست بفصيحة .

KASHSHAF:94:7/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:94:7/r10.speaker: بعض الرافضة
KASHSHAF:94:7/r10.claim: Some Rāfiḍīs read the ṣād with kasra to claim an order to appoint ʿAlī as imam; the author calls this an innovation and rejects it by noting a Nāṣibī could analogously make it an order to hate ʿAlī.
KASHSHAF:94:7/r10.anchor: ومن البدع : ما روى عن بعض الرافضة أنه قرأ : «فانصب » بكسر الصاد ، أي : فانصب علياً للإمامة ؛ ولو صحّ هذا للرافضي لصحّ للناصبي

MAWARDI:94:7/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:94:7/r1.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI:94:7/r1.claim: When finished with obligatory duties, the Prophet should devote himself to standing in night prayer.
MAWARDI:94:7/r1.anchor: أحدها : فإذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب من قيام الليل ، قاله ابن مسعود

MAWARDI:94:7/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:94:7/r2.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI:94:7/r2.claim: When finished praying, the Prophet should devote himself to supplication.
MAWARDI:94:7/r2.anchor: الثاني : فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فانصب في دعائك ، قاله الضحاك

MAWARDI:94:7/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:94:7/r3.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
MAWARDI:94:7/r3.claim: When finished fighting the enemy, the Prophet should devote himself to worship of his Lord.
MAWARDI:94:7/r3.anchor: الثالث : فإذا فرغت من جهادك عدوك فانصب لعبادة ربك ، قاله الحسن وقتادة

MAWARDI:94:7/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:94:7/r4.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI:94:7/r4.claim: When finished with worldly affairs, the Prophet should devote himself to work for the Hereafter.
MAWARDI:94:7/r4.anchor: الرابع : فإذا فرغت من أمر دنياك فانصب في عمل آخرتك ، قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI:94:7/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:94:7/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI:94:7/r5.claim: A further possibility is that after delivering the message, the Prophet should devote himself to fighting his enemy.
MAWARDI:94:7/r5.anchor: ويحتمل تأويلا خامسا : فإذا فرغت من إبلاغ الرسالة فانصب لجهاد عدوك

NASAFI:94:7/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:94:7/r1.claim: When finished calling people, the Prophet should strive in worship of the Lord.
NASAFI:94:7/r1.anchor: أي فإذا فرغت من دعوة الخلق فاجتهد في عبادة الرب

NASAFI:94:7/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:94:7/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
NASAFI:94:7/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says that when the Prophet finishes prayer he should exert himself in supplication.
NASAFI:94:7/r2.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : فإذا فرغت من صلاتك فاجتهد في الدعاء

NASAFI:94:7/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:94:7/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI:94:7/r3.claim: Scholars disagree whether that supplication is before or after the salutation ending prayer.
NASAFI:94:7/r3.anchor: واختلف أنه قبل السلام أو بعده

NASAFI:94:7/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:94:7/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI:94:7/r4.claim: Past blessings and future promises urge gratitude and sustained worship.
NASAFI:94:7/r4.anchor: لما عدد عليه نعمه السالفة ومواعيده الآتية بعثه على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة

QURTUBI:94:7/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r1.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة
QURTUBI:94:7/r1.claim: When you finish prayer, intensify supplication and ask God for what you need.
QURTUBI:94:7/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس وقتادة : فإذا فرغت من صلاتك

QURTUBI:94:7/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
QURTUBI:94:7/r2.claim: When you finish the obligatory prayers, devote yourself to standing in night prayer.
QURTUBI:94:7/r2.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل .

QURTUBI:94:7/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r3.speaker: الكلبي
QURTUBI:94:7/r3.claim: When you finish conveying the message, seek forgiveness for yourself and for believing men and women.
QURTUBI:94:7/r3.anchor: وقال الكلبي : إذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة

QURTUBI:94:7/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r4.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
QURTUBI:94:7/r4.claim: When you finish fighting your enemy, devote yourself to worship of your Lord.
QURTUBI:94:7/r4.anchor: وقال الحسن وقتادة أيضا : إذا فرغت من جهاد عدوك ، فانصب لعبادة ربك .

QURTUBI:94:7/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r5.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI:94:7/r5.claim: When you finish worldly affairs, devote yourself to prayer; a similar explanation is transmitted from al-Hasan.
QURTUBI:94:7/r5.anchor: وعن مجاهد :  " فإذا فرغت "  من دنياك ،    " فانصب "  في صلاتك

QURTUBI:94:7/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r6.speaker: الجنيد
QURTUBI:94:7/r6.claim: When you finish dealing with creation, strive in worship of the Real.
QURTUBI:94:7/r6.anchor: وقال الجنيد : إذا فرغت من أمر الخلق ، فاجتهد في عبادة الحق .

QURTUBI:94:7/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r7.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI:94:7/r7.claim: Ibn al-Arabi rejects an innovator reading with kasra and initial hamza that takes the verse to mean appoint a successor-imam; it is invalid in reading and meaning, since the Prophet appointed no successor.
QURTUBI:94:7/r7.anchor: قال ابن العربي :  " ومن المبتدعة من قرأ هذه الآية

QURTUBI:94:7/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI:94:7/r8.claim: Some ignorant people doubled the b and read it as urging return home after jihad. Qurtubi rejects the reading as contrary to consensus, though he accepts its meaning on the basis of a travel report.

QURTUBI:94:7/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI:94:7/r9.claim: The Prophet said travel is a piece of torment that prevents sleep, food, and drink, so after completing one's need one should hurry back to one's family; this supports the meaning of returning home.
QURTUBI:94:7/r9.anchor: لقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم : [ السفر قطعة من العذاب ، يمنع أحدكم نومه وطعامه وشرابه ، فإذا قضى أحدكم نهمته ، فليعجل الرجوع إلى أهله ]

QURTUBI:94:7/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI:94:7/r10.claim: Qurtubi condemns taking a sound meaning and attaching to it a self-invented reading or hadith, because that makes one lie about God and His Messenger.
QURTUBI:94:7/r10.anchor: وأشد الناس عذابا وأسوأهم مباء ومآبا ، من أخذ معنى صحيحا ، فركب عليه من قبل نفسه قراءة أو حديثا ، فيكون كاذبا على الله

QURTUBI:94:7/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:94:7/r13.speaker: أبو السمال
QURTUBI:94:7/r13.claim: Abu al-Sammal read faraghta with kasra on the rāʾ; Qurtubi identifies it as a dialectal form.
QURTUBI:94:7/r13.anchor: وروي عن أبي السمال  " فإذا فرغت "  بكسر الراء ، وهي لغة فيه .

RAZI:94:7/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:94:7/r1.claim: After recalling past favors and promising future ones, God urges gratitude and strenuous worship: when one task ends, undertake worship.
RAZI:94:7/r1.anchor: لا جرم بعثه على الشكر والاجتهاد في العبادة

RAZI:94:7/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:94:7/r2.claim: In this command, inṣab means exert yourself or toil; the verb is used as naṣiba yanṣabu.

RAZI:94:7/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r3.speaker: قتادة والضحاك ومقاتل
RAZI:94:7/r3.claim: After completing the obligatory prayer, exert yourself in supplication to God and ask Him, and He will grant your request.
RAZI:94:7/r3.anchor: قال قتادة والضحاك ومقاتل : إذا فرغت من الصلاة المكتوبة

RAZI:94:7/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r4.speaker: الشعبي
RAZI:94:7/r4.claim: Al-Shaʿbī says to supplicate for worldly and afterlife needs after finishing the tashahhud.
RAZI:94:7/r4.anchor: وقال الشعبي : إذا فرغت من التشهد فادع لدنياك وآخرتك

RAZI:94:7/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r5.speaker: مجاهد
RAZI:94:7/r5.claim: Mujāhid interprets the instruction as turning from worldly business to exertion in prayer.
RAZI:94:7/r5.anchor: وقال مجاهد : إذا فرغت من أمر دنياك فانصب وصل

RAZI:94:7/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r6.speaker: عبد الله
RAZI:94:7/r6.claim: ʿAbd Allāh says that after the obligatory duties one should devote oneself to the night vigil.
RAZI:94:7/r6.anchor: وقال عبد الله : إذا فرغت من الفرائض فانصب في قيام الليل

RAZI:94:7/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r7.speaker: الحسن
RAZI:94:7/r7.claim: Al-Ḥasan says that after a military expedition one should strive in worship.
RAZI:94:7/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن : إذا فرغت من الغزو فاجتهد في العبادة

RAZI:94:7/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r8.speaker: علي بن أبي طلحة
RAZI:94:7/r8.claim: ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭalḥa says that when healthy, one should turn free time into exertion in worship.
RAZI:94:7/r8.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طلحة : إذا كنت صحيحا فانصب

RAZI:94:7/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r9.speaker: شريح
RAZI:94:7/r9.claim: Shurayḥ saw two men wrestling and remarked that an idle person was not commanded to do that; he invoked the verse's call to exert oneself.
RAZI:94:7/r9.anchor: أن شريحا مر برجلين يتصارعان ، فقال : الفارغ ما أمر بهذا

RAZI:94:7/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:94:7/r10.speaker: author
RAZI:94:7/r10.claim: The general instruction is to follow one act of worship with another and leave no time empty of worship.
RAZI:94:7/r10.anchor: أن يواصل بين بعض العبادات وبعض

TAB:94:7/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:94:7/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says that after finishing the prescribed prayer one should ask God, turn to Him in desire, and strive in devotion.
TAB:94:7/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ يقول :  فإذا فرغت مما فُرض عليك من الصلاة فسل الله

TAB:94:7/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:94:7/r2.claim: Mujahid says that when one rises to pray, one should strive in presenting one’s need to the Lord.
TAB:94:7/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد ،   قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ قال :  إذا قمت إلى الصلاة فانصَب في حاجتك إلى ربك

TAB:94:7/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r3.speaker: الضحاك
TAB:94:7/r3.claim: Al-Dahhak interprets this as striving in supplication after the obligatory prayer but before saying the salutation.
TAB:94:7/r3.anchor: سمعت الضحاك يقول في قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ يقول :  من الصلاة المكتوبة قبل أن نسلّم ،   فانْصَبْ

TAB:94:7/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r4.speaker: قتادة
TAB:94:7/r4.claim: Qatada says that after finishing prayer the Prophet was commanded to be earnest in supplication.
TAB:94:7/r4.anchor: عن قتادة ،   قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ وَإلى رَبّكَ فارْغَبْ قال :  أمره إذا فرغ من صلاته أن يبالغ في دعائه .

TAB:94:7/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r5.speaker: الحسن
TAB:94:7/r5.claim: Al-Hasan says that after finishing a military campaign the Prophet should devote himself earnestly to supplication and worship.
TAB:94:7/r5.anchor: عن قتادة ،   قال :  قال الحسن في قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ قال :  أمره إذا فرغ من غزوه ،   أن يجتهد في الدعاء والعبادة .

TAB:94:7/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r6.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB:94:7/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd transmits from his father that after the jihad against the Arabs ended, the Prophet should turn to worship and desire his Lord.
TAB:94:7/r6.anchor: قال ابن زيد ،   في قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ قال عن أبيه :  فإذا فرغت من الجهاد

TAB:94:7/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r7.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:94:7/r7.claim: Mujahid says that after finishing worldly affairs one should exert oneself in prayer.
TAB:94:7/r7.anchor: عن منصور ،   عن مجاهد فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ فانْصَبْ قال :  إذا فرغت من أمر دنياك فانْصَبْ ،   فصلّ .

TAB:94:7/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r8.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:94:7/r8.claim: Mujahid also says that after worldly affairs, when one rises for prayer, one should direct desire and intention to God.
TAB:94:7/r8.anchor: عن مجاهد ،   في قوله :  فَإذَا فَرَغْتَ قال :  إذا فرغت من أمر الدنيا ،   وقمت إلى الصلاة ،   فاجعل رغبتك ونيتك له .

TAB:94:7/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:94:7/r9.speaker: author
TAB:94:7/r9.claim: Al-Tabari prefers a general reading: whenever free from any worldly or religious task, the Prophet should exert himself in worship, pursue what brings him near to God, and ask his needs; the conditional is unrestricted, so no particular kind of free time is singled out.
TAB:94:7/r9.anchor: أمر نبيه أن يجعل فراغه من كلّ ما كان به مشتغلاً ،   من أمر دنياه وآخرته

ITQAN:v2p339#3/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p339#3/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p339#3/r1.claim: The phrase fa-nṣab means to engage in supplication.

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r1.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r1.claim: Although ordinary usage seldom says that meanings are composed, it describes the same process as arranging, building, and linking meanings in the mind.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r1.anchor: وذلك قولهم : إنه يرتب المعاني في نفسه ، وينزلها ويبني بعضها على بعض

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r2.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r2.claim: The analogies of weaving, embroidery, engraving, and craft concern meanings; therefore نظم likewise describes relations among meanings, not words alone.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r2.anchor: استعاروا النسج والوشي والنقش والصياغة لنفس ما استعاروا له النظم

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r3.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r3.claim: A word has no identifiable place apart from its meaning, so ordering in speech begins with ordering meanings.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r3.anchor: لا يتصور أن تعرف للفظ موضعا من غير أن تعرف معناه

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r4.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r4.claim: Once meanings are arranged mentally, their words fall into place as their servants; knowing the positions of meanings in the mind is knowing the positions of their spoken expressions.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p58/r4.anchor: إذا فرغت من ترتيب المعاني في نفسك لم تحتج إلى أن تستأنف فكرا في ترتيب الألفاظ
